plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-session-janitor · DSH 会话清理

给 DSH 用的会话记录清理工具：**列表 → 勾选 → 移入回收站 → 可恢复 → 确认后彻底清空**。
删除永不直接抹掉，先移进 `~/.dsh/session-trash/<时间戳>/`，所以手滑也能救回来。

## 两种用法

### 一、独立版（立刻可用，不需要重启 DSH）

双击本目录里的 **`启动会话清理.cmd`**，浏览器会打开 `http://127.0.0.1:8788/dsh-session-janitor/`。
关掉那个最小化的黑窗口即停止服务。端口被占用时可手动跑：

```
node standalone.mjs --port 8899 --open
```

### 二、DSH 插件版（推荐 · 已安装）

**2026-10-18 09:3x 已装进 desktop 档案**（`dsh.profile.bundles` 共 12 项，依赖 `link:` 指向本目录）。
**重启 DSH 后生效**：左侧边栏出现 🧹「会话清理」图标，点开就是完整界面（独立页面，不占会话）。
也可以直接访问 `http://127.0.0.1:<DSH GUI 端口>/dsh-session-janitor/`（由 DSH 自己的 web 服务提供，与 GUI 同源）。

重新安装 / 装到别的档案：

```
node install-plugin.mjs            # 演练：只打印将要做什么
node install-plugin.mjs --apply    # 真装（会先备份 profile 的 package.json）
```

卸载：把 `dsh-session-janitor` 从 profile `package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 里删掉、
并执行 `pnpm remove dsh-session-janitor`（或直接用备份 `package.json.bak-<时间戳>` 覆盖回去），然后重启 DSH。

> 客户端半侧是**手写的 `lib/client.js`**（无构建步骤），走 `sidebar.panellist` + `main` 两个槽位；
> 宿主半侧 `lib/index.js` 注册同源 HTTP 路由。二者靠 `cordis.patch.yml` 里的宿主条目被发现。

## 界面能做什么

| 区块 | 操作 |
|---|---|
| 会话记录 | 勾选 → 移入回收站；「只选 30 天前」一键勾选老会话；`全选 / 清空选择` |
| 归档缓存 | 清理 `session_projcache_archive_manager_v2` 里的历史归档条目 |
| 回收站 | 勾选 → 恢复到原位置；`彻底清空回收站`（不可恢复） |
| 顶部 | `刷新`、`打开回收站文件夹`、`打开会话目录`、`强制` 开关 |

- **使用中保护**：会话的“最后活动时间”取 `session.v4.jsonl.zstd` 的 mtime，
  最近 **10 分钟**内被写过的会话标黄，默认**服务端拒绝删除**（勾「强制」才放行）。
- **同时清理列表缓存**：删会话时会把 `storages/session_projcache/sessions/<id>.json`
  一起移进回收站，恢复时一并还原，避免出现“缓存有、正文没”的孤儿条目。
- **安全**：只监听 `127.0.0.1`；每个请求都校验 `Host` 必须是本机回环、
  `Origin` 必须同源、`Sec-Fetch-Site` 不能是 `cross-site`，否则 403。
  所有路径都做白名单校验（禁止 `..` 与目录穿越）。

## 目录与接口

被测数据的默认根目录是 `~/.dsh`（可用环境变量 `DSCC_ROOT` 覆盖，测试用）：

```
sessions/<项目>/<会话>/session.v4.jsonl.zstd                       会话正文
storages/session_projcache/sessions/<sessionId>.json              标题 / cwd / 轮数
storages/session_projcache_archive_manager_v2/sessions/*.json      已裁剪归档
session-trash/<时间戳>/manifest.json                               本工具的回收站（含还原路径）
```

HTTP 接口（插件版挂在 DSH 端口，独立版在 8788）：

```
GET  /dsh-session-janitor/            网页界面
GET  /dsh-session-janitor/api/ping    存活探测 + 数据根目录
GET  /dsh-session-janitor/api/list    会话 / 归档 / 回收站清单
POST /dsh-session-janitor/api/trash   {items:[{kind:"session",project,id}|{kind:"archive",file}],force?}
POST /dsh-session-janitor/api/restore {ids:["<桶>:<序号>"]}
POST /dsh-session-janitor/api/purge   {bucket?}
POST /dsh-session-janitor/api/reveal  {what:"trash"|"sessions"}
```

## 开发 / 自测

```
node --check lib/store.js
node --check lib/index.js
```

`lib/store.js` 是纯文件系统逻辑（不依赖 DSH），用临时假目录即可全量回归；
`lib/index.js` 的路由可用假 `ctx` + 假 `req/res` 直接调 `apply(ctx)` 验证。

## 已知边界

- 插件版要 **重启 DSH** 才会挂上路由；独立版不需要。
- 「使用中」判定靠写入时间，不是文件锁：正在被写入的会话靠 10 分钟窗口 + 文件占用（rename 失败）双重保护。
- 只处理会话与归档缓存；**不动** `schedule.json`、`workspace.json`、用量账本等运行状态。

## 收录到插件市场（awesome-dsh-plugin）

本插件按市场规范投稿：**一个 YAML 条目文件**（`data/plugins/<owner>__dsh-session-janitor.yml`）
就是全部投稿内容，市场从 **GitHub 仓库**安装（npm 发布是可选的，只影响市场显示下载量）。

仓库侧要求（都已满足）：`package.json` 声明 `dsh.bundle`（`./cordis.patch.yml`）、仓库根有
`cordis.patch.yml`、仓库带 `dsh-plugin` topic、仓库创建满 1 天、代码真实可用。
投稿条目内容见 `market-entry.yml`（市场只收 GitHub 仓库，一个 YAML 文件就是全部投稿）。

## 作者 / 许可

- 作者：**dsh**
- 许可：MIT（见 `LICENSE`）

plugins.description: Noema long-term memory plugin for DSH: durable, inspectable agent memory with recall tools and a settings page.
plugins.readme_text:
DSH Noema

Long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness — durable, inspectable agent memory backed by Noema.
Recall Before Work • Import From 9 Agent Tools • Settings-Page Memory Management • Crash Keep-Alive • Hot Reload

npm: @zseven-w/dsh-noema · Tested with DSH 0.2.0-rc.2

English · 简体中文 · 繁體中文 · 日本語 · 한국어 · Français · Español · Deutsch · Português · Русский · हिन्दी · Türkçe · ไทย · Tiếng Việt · Bahasa Indonesia


The Noema Memory settings page — import sources, memory management, and live server status

## Why DSH Noema DSH Noema connects [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) with [Noema](https://github.com/ZSeven-W/noema) — a local-first, non-vector memory system for coding agents — so an Agent keeps durable knowledge across sessions instead of starting every conversation from zero.
### 🧠 Durable Recall Memories persist as inspectable Markdown files under `NOEMA_ROOT` (default `~/.agent-memory/`). `noema_recall` loads relevant context at the start of a session; `noema_search`, `noema_browse`, `noema_catalog`, and `noema_recall_graph` cover lookup, exploration, and auditing. ### 📥 Import From Other Tools `noema_import` reads the memory files of ten other AI coding tools — Codex, Claude Code, opencode, Cursor, Grok, WorkBuddy, Antigravity, Trae, Qoder, Hermes — splits them into sections, and saves each as a durable memory. A content-keyed ledger deduplicates across runs and across tools that share files.
### 🛠️ Settings-Page Management The Noema Memory settings page configures the server command, memory root, budgets, idle/call timeouts, and the guidance section — and a Manage memories card searches, browses, adds, reviews, and deletes stored memories directly. ### 🩺 Keep-Alive The memory server stays up: idle timeout defaults to never, and a keep-alive loop restarts the `noema-mcp` child in the background when it crashes or exits, with a configurable check interval and restart backoff.
### 🔍 Smart Entity Extraction Noema's extraction engine combines jieba word segmentation with high-precision signals — English proper nouns, CJK names and technical terms, quoted topics, and repetition — with stopword and path filters, so the PageIndex topic catalog stays clean. ### ⚡ Hot Reload After the first boot, the plugin never needs a restart again: `pnpm run build` hot-reloads the host plugin through Cordis HMR, and `ppnpm run build:client` hot-swaps the browser bundle over the client-hmr SSE channel.
## Install into DSH ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add @zseven-w/dsh-noema@latest dsh web ``` Or, for local development straight from the source tree: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add link:/path/to/dsh-noema dsh web ``` The `link:` protocol symlinks the profile dependency to this repository, so rebuilds are visible immediately and Cordis HMR can watch the compiled output. The plugin bundles the `noema-mcp` binary through per-platform optional npm packages. To build it yourself instead, run `cargo build --release -p noema-mcp` inside the bundled `noema` submodule, or point the Server command setting at any `noema-mcp` build. ## Memory Tools The model-facing tools mirror the Noema MCP surface: | Tool | What it does | | --- | --- | | `noema_recall` | Recall relevant memories for a query, with a token budget. | | `noema_search` | Full-text search over stored memories. | | `noema_browse` | Browse the PageIndex catalog for a topic or entity. | | `noema_catalog` | Render the full memory catalog as markdown. | | `noema_recall_graph` | Multi-hop recall through links and shared entities. | | `noema_neighbors` | One graph hop from a memory. | | `noema_explain` | Explain why a memory was or was not recalled. | | `noema_remember` | Save a durable fact, decision, constraint, or preference. | | `noema_review_list` | List pending review candidates. | | `noema_review_decide` | Accept, reject, edit, or merge a candidate. | | `noema_forget` | Tombstone or hard-delete a memory. | | `noema_policy_get` / `noema_policy_set` | Read or update the write policy. | | `noema_status` | Server and tenant status: counts, index health, storage root. | | `noema_import` | Import memories from other AI coding tools. | Each tool returns a uniform envelope `{ ok, tool, text }` where `text` carries the full server output. ## Import memories from other tools | Source id | Global files | Workspace files | | --- | --- | --- | | `codex` | `~/.codex/AGENTS.md` + the Codex memory pipeline: `~/.codex/memories/MEMORY.md`, `memory_summary.md`, `rollout_summaries/*.md`, `extensions/ad_hoc/notes/*.md` (`raw_memories.md` skipped — it is the uncurated feed) | `AGENTS.md`, `AGENTS.local.md` | | `claude-code` | `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md`, `~/.claude/CLAUDE.local.md`, `~/.claude/MEMORY.md` | `CLAUDE.md`, `CLAUDE.local.md`, `MEMORY.md` | | `opencode` | `~/.config/opencode/AGENTS.md` | `AGENTS.md` | | `cursor` | `~/.cursor/rules/*.mdc`, `~/.cursorrules` | `.cursor/rules/*.mdc`, `.cursorrules` | | `grok` | `~/.grok/AGENTS.md` + the Grok cross-session memory: `~/.grok/memory/MEMORY.md`, per-project `MEMORY.md`, and `sessions/*.md` summaries | `AGENTS.md` | | `workbuddy` | `~/.codebuddy/CODEBUDDY.md` (WorkBuddy memory file), `~/.workbuddy/AGENTS.md`, `~/.workbuddy/memory.md`, `~/.config/workbuddy/AGENTS.md`, `~/Library/Application Support/WorkBuddy/AGENTS.md` | `AGENTS.md`, `CODEBUDDY.md` | | `antigravity` | `~/.antigravity/AGENTS.md`, `~/.config/antigravity/AGENTS.md`, `~/Library/Application Support/Antigravity/AGENTS.md` (best-effort; no documented global memory store yet) | `AGENTS.md`, `AGENTS.local.md` | | `trae` | `~/.trae/AGENTS.md`, `~/.trae/memory/`, `~/.trae/rules/` (plus the `~/.trae-cn` variants) | `AGENTS.md`, `.trae/rules/` | | `qoder` | `~/.qoder-cn/AGENTS.md`, `~/.qoder-cn/rules/`, the auto-memory roots `~/.qoder-cn/memory/` and `~/.qoder-cn/projects/*/memory/` (plus plugins.description: WIP (not published yet): Gemini CLI subagent for DeepSeek Harness. Gemini CLI does not offer Gemini 4 yet; use dsh-subagent-antigravity for Gemini 4.
plugins.readme_text:
---
description: "Gemini subagent: drive the official Google Gemini CLI as a one-shot coding subagent inside DeepSeek Harness (subagent_gemini delegation tool)."
kind: "package-bundle"
---

# dsh-subagent-gemini

> **发布状态：暂未发布到 npm / DSH 插件市场。**
> Gemini CLI 目前尚未提供 Gemini 4，且本插件需要用户自备 Gemini API key 才能完成端到端验证；
> 在验证通过前不提交市场收录，避免把未经验证的插件放给用户。代码、测试与 CI 均已就绪，验证后可发布。
>
> 想用 Gemini 4 请安装 [`dsh-subagent-antigravity`](https://github.com/PipeDream941/dsh-subagent-antigravity)。

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

Adds a **Gemini subagent** to DeepSeek Harness (DSH): a parent session can call
`subagent_gemini` to run a Google Gemini CLI coding agent in a **separate process**
inside the parent workspace, let it edit files and run commands on its own, and
get only the final answer back.

The shape is the same as the official Codex subagent (`subagent_codex`) and the
community Cursor subagent (`cursor_code`):

- **Fresh process, fresh session** — every delegation spawns a new `gemini --acp`;
- **Final answer only** — the child's thoughts, tool calls and stderr never enter the parent conversation;
- **One task per run** — no follow-up input or continuation (use the native `subagent`/`fork` backends for those);
- **Safe diagnostics** — failures report fixed stage/category facts, never stderr, paths or credentials.

> Community plugin; not affiliated with Google. Gemini CLI is Google's official CLI — this plugin only drives it from DSH.

## How it works

```
parent session (DeepSeek model)
   │  calls tool subagent_gemini({ description, prompt })
   ▼
DSH subagent seam (ctx.subagents)
   │  provider: gemini (registered by this plugin)
   ▼
@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-acp (official ACP subagent backend)
   │  spawn, ACP handshake, auto-answered permissions, process-range cleanup, safe diagnostics
   ▼
gemini --acp --skip-trust  (separate process, parent cwd)
   │  uses Gemini CLI's own tools (file edits / shell / search / MCP …)
   ▼
final answer → parent conversation
```

This plugin owns the Gemini-specific parts — **locating the executable**, **validating configuration**
and **detecting credentials at load time with actionable guidance**. Process lifecycle and the ACP
protocol are handled by DSH's official backend, so a DSH upgrade does not require rewriting the protocol here.

## Requirements

| Dependency | Version / notes |
|---|---|
| DeepSeek Harness | `0.2.1-rc.2` series (provides `ctx.subagents` and the ACP subagent backend) |
| Node.js | `^22.19.0` or `>=24` |
| Google Gemini CLI | a build that supports `--acp` (`0.60+`, latest recommended) |
| Gemini credential | Gemini Developer API key (recommended), or Vertex AI / Code Assist variables |

Install the CLI:

```bash
npm install -g @google/gemini-cli
gemini --version
```

## Install the plugin

**From the DSH plugin market (recommended):** search for `dsh-subagent-gemini`, install and enable it.

**From the command line:**

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-subagent-gemini
```

Then add the package to that profile's `package.json` → `dsh.profile.bundles` and restart (or let the
profile recompose):

```json
"dsh": {
  "profile": {
    "bundles": ["…", "dsh-subagent-gemini"]
  }
}
```

Once enabled, every agent sees the global tool `subagent_gemini` (a running session picks it up on its next request).

## Credentials (important)

Gemini CLI needs its own credential. **Google account browser login (OAuth) no longer works**: Google retired
the individual Gemini Code Assist OAuth client for Gemini CLI, and the CLI reports
*"This client is no longer supported for Gemini Code Assist for individuals"*.
Use an **API key** instead:

1. Create a key at <https://aistudio.google.com/apikey>;
2. Store it where Gemini CLI looks (no plugin config required):

```bash
printf 'GEMINI_API_KEY=your-key\n' > ~/.gemini/.env
chmod 600 ~/.gemini/.env
```

Gemini CLI loads `~/.gemini/.env` automatically. Environment variables also work:

- `GEMINI_API_KEY` — Gemini Developer API;
- `GOOGLE_GENAI_USE_VERTEXAI=true` + `GOOGLE_API_KEY` — Vertex AI;
- `GOOGLE_GENAI_USE_GCA=true` — Google Code Assist license.

To pass variables to the child explicitly, use the plugin's `env` config (see below). The plugin never reads,
logs or returns secret values.

## Usage

The model calls it like any other delegation tool:

```json
{
  "name": "subagent_gemini",
  "arguments": {
    "description": "Fix login timeout",
    "prompt": "In the workspace, find the login request timeout and raise it from 5s to 15s, run the related tests, and reply only with what you changed and the test result."
  }
}
```

- `description` — 3–5 word task name shown in the subagent list;
- `prompt` — a **self-contained** task; the child cannot see the parent conversation, so include paths, constraints and acceptance criteria.

When the run finishes the parent receives a completion notice with Gemini's final answer or a safe failure
diagnostic. The child's tool traffic and reasoning stay out of the parent session.

## Configuration

Override the `subagent-gemini` entry's `config` in a profile patch:

| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `providerName` | `gemini` | Name registered on `ctx.subagents`; must be unique in one profile |
| `command` | empty (auto-detect) | Path to the `gemini` executable; empty searches `PATH`, then `~/.local/bin`, `/opt/homebrew/bin`, `/usr/local/bin`, … |
| `args` | `['--acp', '--skip-trust']` | CLI arguments; `--acp` is always kept, `--skip-trust` is present by default |
| `model` | empty (CLI default) | Fixed model id such as `gemini-2.5-flash`; becomes one `--model` argument |
| `permission` | `allow` | Auto-answer for child permission requests: `allow` approves (edits/shell), `reject` declines (read-only) |
| `env` | `{}` | Extra environment variables layered over the credential-scrubbed parent environment |
| `disposeEofGraceMs` | `6000` | Time the child gets to flush after stdin EOF before escalation |
| `disposeGraceMs` | `3000` | Failure-observation and SIGTERM→SIGKILL escalation grace |

Example — fixed model, read-only child:

```yaml
- id: subagent-gemini
  config:
    model: gemini-2.5-flash
    permission: reject
```

## Security and permissions

- `permission: allow` means **unattended**: the child may edit workspace files and run commands without a human
  approval prompt. That is what makes delegated coding tasks possible; use it in trusted workspaces and review
  `git diff` afterwards.
- `--skip-trust` trusts the parent workspace for the child session only, so a delegation never stalls on an
  interactive trust prompt.
- The child is a separate process with its own credential environment: DSH's subprocess seam scrubs credential-like
  variables from the parent environment; only variables in `env` are forwarded.
- No telemetry. No credential is read, logged or returned by this plugin; the key is managed by Gemini CLI itself.

## Troubleshooting

| Symptom | Fix |
|---|---|
| Delegation fails with a `process-start` diagnostic | `gemini` not found. `npm install -g @google/gemini-cli`, or set `command` to an absolute path |
| `Gemini API key is missing or not configured` | No credential. Write `~/.gemini/.env` as above (`chmod 600`) |
| `This client is no longer supported for Gemini Code Assist for individuals` | The retired OAuth login is in use. Switch to an API key |
| Child starts but never answers / times out | Check network reachability of the Gemini API; if it needs a proxy, put `HTTPS_PROXY` in the plugin's `env` |
| Want to check the machine setup | Run `npm run smoke` in the plugin checkout (costs one API request and prints PONG) |

## Compatibility and development

- Depends on the official `@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-acp@0.2.1-rc.2`, so protocol work tracks the official backend;
- Unit tests: `npm test` (32 cases: config normalization, executable discovery, credential detection);
- End-to-end self-check: `npm run smoke` (requires an API key);
- Reference implementations: the official Codex subagent (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-codex`) and the official ACP
  backend (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-acp`); all three share the same `ctx.subagents` contract.

## Uninstall

```bash
dsh plugin --profile des

plugins.description: A permanent 'Delete session' action for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar, behind a confirmation dialog.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-session-clean-delete

A permanent **Delete session** action for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar, behind a
confirmation dialog that tells you what is about to go.

DSH ships a *Archive* action, which is reversible and keeps the session in the
Archived list. This plugin adds the irreversible counterpart, and — unlike a
naive `rm` of the session log — it actually makes the row disappear.

## What it does

Adds one row to the per-session `…` menu in the left sidebar, ordered after
Pin / Rename / Fork / Archive. Choosing it opens a modal that reports:

- whether the session is **still open on this machine** (it cannot be reopened afterwards),
- the **log size** about to be removed,
- **running turns, subagents, background jobs and reminders** bound to the session,
- how many reminders are deleted with it.

Confirming stops the session's work, unlinks its session directory and projection
checkpoint, and releases the id from every registry that would otherwise keep
listing it. Then the sidebar refreshes and the row is gone.

There is **no undo and no trash folder**. The dialog says so.

## Why it is not just `rm`

A session's directory is not the only thing that makes it appear. The Host's
session corpus is `persistence ∪ live`, so a session the Host still holds live
keeps coming back after its log is deleted:

1. the browser drops the row,
2. the next `sessions.refresh()` rebuilds the rows from the Host list and folds
   the live summary back in,
3. the row **returns**.

The visible symptom of this is that deleting several sessions in a row makes the
earlier ones reappear, and that archived rows come back stuck in Archived forever
(the old id was never removed from the archive set, so it accumulated dead ids).

`release()` therefore detaches through the same teardown the owning fiber uses,
in the order the agent loop's own disposal uses — **agents first, then
sessions** — plus `unarchiveSession(id)` and `workspace.detachSession(id)`. The
browser keeps its own `retired` set and re-applies every retirement after each
refresh, so rows stay retired until the Host's `api-session/removed` agrees.

## Install

This package ships a `dsh.bundle` manifest, so `dsh plugin` installs it as a
profile layer by itself — **you do not need to edit `cordis.patch.yml`**. Bare
`@deepseek-ai/*` imports are resolved by the host itself, so the package declares
**zero dependencies** — do not add them.

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-session-clean-delete
```

That is the npm name, and it is also the repository name.

From a source clone, `dsh plugin` is a pnpm passthrough, so a `file:` path works
too:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add file:/path/to/dsh-session-clean-delete
```

That command does two things: it adds the package as a dependency, **and** it
appends it to `dsh.profile.bundles` in the profile's `package.json`. The second
half is the one people miss — without it the package is just an unused
dependency, because the bundle patch in [`cordis.patch.yml`](cordis.patch.yml)
is only read for packages the bundle list names.

Verify it joined the tree — the entry must appear under a banner naming the
plugin's own `cordis.patch.yml`, which is the part that is easy to miss:

```bash
dsh --profile <profile> --dump-config | grep -B1 session-clean-delete
```

```
# == …/dsh-session-clean-delete/cordis.patch.yml
- id: session-clean-delete
  name: dsh-session-clean-delete
```

A row under a banner for the *profile's* `cordis.patch.yml` means something
inserted this plugin by hand and it is **not** installed as a bundle — the
dependency is present but the layer never composes. `--dump-config` never
mounts, so it is safe against the live profile.

Finally **restart the harness**. The bundle is composed at boot, so there is no
partial effect: until it restarts, the menu row is not there.

### If nothing happens

- **Re-running the same add is a no-op** — same spec, same version.
  `rm -rf ~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/node_modules/dsh-session-clean-delete` first, or
  the profile keeps serving the old copy forever.
- pnpm **copies** the package into the profile rather than symlinking it, so
  editing your clone does not change the running plugin. Copy
  `lib/*.js` into `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/node_modules/dsh-session-clean-delete/lib/`.
  `client.js` hot-reloads; `index.js` is host-side and needs a restart.
- `dsh plugin` needs `pnpm` on `PATH` (`corepack enable pnpm`), or it fails with
  "pnpm was not found".
- pnpm installs a version **older** than the registry `latest` when a release is
  less than 24 h old — that is `minimumReleaseAge`, a supply-chain guardrail, not
  a stale cache. Wait, or use a `^x.y.z` range so the newer release arrives on
  its own.

## Design notes

**A Typert `Remote` service, not an HTTP route.** The host half registers one
`TypertRemoteService` named `sessionDelete` with `describe` and `deleteSession`.
The Gateway auto-claims every endpoint a live `TypertRemoteService` declares, and
the browser calls it over the ordinary channel:

```js
ctx.connection.rpc.call('/api', `sessionDelete/${method}`, { args: { request } })
```

So there is no route to register and no permission to grant — the browser peer is
the owner principal.

**It deliberately does not check `Origin`.** In the desktop app the renderer
origin is the custom scheme `dsh-app://app`, and the shell's `protocol.handle`
strips `origin`, `host`, `cookie` and `sec-fetch-site` before forwarding to the
Host. A plugin route that validates `origin === 'http://' + host` therefore 403s
*every* request from the desktop app while working fine under `dsh web`. The
Remote-service path avoids the question entirely.

**The postcondition is checked against the disk.** A successful `rm` is not
treated as proof; `removeLog()` stats the path afterwards and throws
`delete/failed` if it survived.

## Files

| Path | Role |
| --- | --- |
| `lib/index.js` | Host half: `TypertRemoteService`, the delete sequence, registry release. |
| `lib/client.js` | Browser half: the menu row and the `shell.overlay` confirmation dialog. |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Bundle patch named by `dsh.bundle`; inserts this plugin into a profile. |
| `locale/en.json`, `locale/zh.json` | Plugin titles for the Plugins panel. |

The in-app dictionary lives in `lib/client.js` (`zh` is the key-set source of
truth, `en` is checked complete against it); `locale/*.json` is the metadata the
Plugins panel reads.

## License

MIT — see [LICENSE](LICENSE).

plugins.description: Agent Teams 泳道看板 for DeepSeek Harness — 依赖 DAG 连线 + 通讯流，布局移植自 cc-haha
plugins.readme_text:
dsh-team-canvas

Agent Teams 泳道看板 · 依赖 DAG 连线 · 通讯流
DeepSeek Harness 插件 · 布局移植自 cc-haha 开源实现

--- ## 它是什么 在 DSH 会话输入框上方放一块 **Agent Teams 可视化画布**：队长居中、成员在下、任务按依赖深度分泳道排列，中间用 **SVG 贝塞尔虚线**画出「谁依赖谁」和「谁正在做哪个任务」。 CC-haha 桌面端的 Agent Teams 面板有一套很好用的视觉语言 —— 泳道底板、虚线总线、任务卡状态徽章。这个插件把那套布局搬到 DSH 的 Web UI 里，用的是原版几何常量与路径算法，不是照着重画的近似版本。 ## 长什么样 ``` ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ 🤖 Agent Teams [tally-squad] [实验特性] │ ├──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤ │ 3/6 2 8 1 │ │ 并行执行 完成 进行中 待办 │ ├───────────────────────────────────┬──────────────────────────┤ │ 1 · 团队 · 队长居中，成员在下 │ 通讯 88 条 │ │ │ 全部 | 报告 | 私信 │ │ 🤖 team-lead ├──────────────────────────┤ │ 协调·等待汇报·收件箱 51 │ 👩‍💻 frontend-dev 17:15 │ │ ┆ ┆ ┆ ┆ │ P1 已修，mobile.png... │ │ 👨‍💻 🧪 🔍 👩‍💻 │ │ │ backend qa-eng reviewer frontend│ 🤖 team-lead 17:15 │ │ │ 后端 8000 已停... │ │ 2 · 共享任务列表 · 按依赖排层 → │ │ │ ┌─无依赖·可立即做─┐┌─第2层─┐┌收尾┐│ 👩‍💻 frontend-dev 17:14 │ │ │ #1 后端实现 ═══╪╪═▶#4 ││ #6 ││ 你抓到的真实 bug... │ │ │ #2 前端实现 ═══╪╪═▶#5 ││ ││ │ │ │ #3 QA 阶段一 ✓ ││ ││ ││ │ │ └────────────────┘└──────┘└────┘│ │ ├───────────────────────────────────┴──────────────────────────┤ │ ┄┄ 依赖未满足 ┄┄ 依赖已满足 ┄┄ 正在执行 ┄┄ 刚解锁 ┄┄ 飞行中 │ └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ ``` ## 连线怎么画的 这是本插件的核心。四条连线各司其职： | 连线 | 形状 | 虚线 | 含义 | |---|---|---|---| | **任务依赖** | 三次贝塞尔，前置任务右缘 → 后继任务左缘 | `7 7` | 满足时用负责人强调色并流动，未满足用边框色 | | **队长总线** | 折线：队长脚下 → 横向总线 → 各成员顶部 | `6 6` | 汇报关系 | | **成员 peer 总线** | 折线：成员脚下 → 横向总线 → 成员脚下 | `4 7` | 同级通讯 | | **执行 tether** | 三次贝塞尔，成员脚下 → 任务顶部 | `8 6` | 正在执行该任务的成员，流动动画 | 依赖边的路径函数： ```js function dependencyPath(from, to) { const fromX = from.x + TASK_WIDTH const fromY = from.y + TASK_HEIGHT / 2 const toX = to.x const toY = to.y + TASK_HEIGHT / 2 const middle = fromX + (toX - fromX) / 2 return `M ${fromX},${fromY} C ${middle},${fromY} ${middle},${toY} ${toX - 5},${toY}` } ``` 泳道划分用「最长依赖路径」算深度，带环与缺失节点兜底： ```js function depthOf(id) { if (depths.has(id)) return depths.get(id) if (visiting.has(id)) return 0 // 环 → 回退 0 const task = byId.get(id) if (!task) return 0 // 缺失节点 → 0 visiting.add(id) const deps = task.blockedBy.filter(d => byId.has(d)) const depth = deps.length === 0 ? 0 : 1 + Math.max(...deps.map(depthOf)) visiting.delete(id) depths.set(id, depth) return depth } ``` 卡片是普通 DOM 绝对定位，连线是叠在上面的一层 `

plugins.description: A local token usage, API call, and cache statistics dashboard for DeepSeek Harness.
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH-TokenDashboard **Your local token usage, API calls, and cache activity in one dashboard.** A lightweight plugin for DeepSeek Harness. No build step. No runtime dependencies. No additional API key. [English](README.md) · [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE) ![Runtime dependencies: 0](https://img.shields.io/badge/runtime_dependencies-0-brightgreen.svg) ![Built for DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/built_for-DeepSeek_Harness-4D6BFE.svg) [Features](#features) · [Quick start](#quick-start) · [How counting works](#how-counting-works) · [FAQ](#faq)
_Preview uses sample data. The plugin follows your DSH theme._ ## Why DSH-TokenDashboard? See how much you use across sessions, which projects drive token consumption, and how often your input hits the cache. The dashboard reads existing session logs in your current DSH profile and presents the results inside the native sidebar. ## Features | Feature | What you get | | ---------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | Usage at a glance | Total tokens, API calls, uncached input, output, cache reads, and cache hit rate | | Flexible summaries | Last 7, 30, or 90 days, or all time, with active session counts | | Activity calendar | 52 weeks of square, rounded cells; hover or focus for exact daily numbers | | Daily cache trends | Stacked input tokens: cache misses below cache hits, with a visible zero baseline | | Adjustable chart range | Zoom from 7 to 30 days; compact K/M/B axis labels | | Model and project breakdowns | Token rankings and API call counts by model/provider and working directory | | Native presentation | Light/dark themes, responsive layout, English and Simplified Chinese | | Refresh controls | Manual refresh or automatic refresh every 30 seconds; polling pauses while the page is hidden | ## Quick start ### 1. Install from npm Use the DSH CLI available in your installation: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add @ningtian-byte/dsh-tokendashboard ``` Alternatively, install directly from GitHub: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add github:NingTiAn-byte/DSH-TokenDashboard ``` ### 2. Desktop or local installation For Desktop, use the CLI bundled with the Desktop application: ```sh dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:NingTiAn-byte/DSH-TokenDashboard ``` Alternatively, download **Code → Download ZIP**, extract it, and install the directory containing `package.json` through the DSH plugin manager or CLI: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add "/absolute/path/to/DSH-TokenDashboard" ``` On Windows, paths such as `C:/plugins/DSH-TokenDashboard` work as well. Quote paths that contain spaces. If `dsh` is not on PATH, use its installed executable or command file. The source CLI may reject the Desktop profile; use the Desktop-bundled CLI for that profile. ### 3. Open the dashboard Restart DSH and select **Usage statistics** in the sidebar. Existing completed requests appear automatically; the plugin does not need to run a new model request. > **Compatibility:** Requires DSH with `sessionPersistence`, `connection`, slot, locale, and theme APIs. DSH plugin APIs may change between releases; check compatibility with your installed version. ## Using the dashboard - Select a summary range at the top. Summary metrics and rankings follow this range. - Hover over or keyboard-focus a calendar cell or daily bar for exact usage and API call counts. Press **Escape** to dismiss the tooltip. - Drag the trend slider to show the latest **7–30 days**. One month means a rolling 30-day window. - Calendar history and the trend window are independent of the summary range. Changing that range preserves the trend zoom. - Toggle automatic refresh at the bottom of the page. ## How counting works | Metric | Definition | | -------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | | Total tokens | Provider-reported `totalTokens`, or uncached input + output + cache reads + cache writes when unavailable | | Input | Uncached input only; excludes cache reads and writes | | Output | Provider-reported output; reasoning tokens are not added a second time | | Cache hit rate | Cache reads ÷ (uncached input + cache reads + cache writes); `—` when the denominator is zero | | API calls | Settled `assistant/message` and `assistant/attempt` records, including settled failures and attempts without usage | | Daily bars | Input only: cache miss = uncached input + cache writes; cache hit = cache reads | | Sessions | Sessions with at least one settled request in the selected summary range | An in-progress request appears after settlement. Requests without usage increase the API call count but do not add estimated tokens. Repeated settlements for the same attempt are deduplicated; retry attempts count separately, and inherited fork records are excluded. Days follow the browser's IANA time zone. Calendar weeks start on Monday. Output contributes to total tokens and tooltip details, but is not stacked in the input-cache chart. ## Data and privacy The plugin reads local session logs through read-only handles. It does not modify logs, call model APIs, or upload usage data. Numeric summaries, model names, session IDs, and working directories are kept in memory for the dashboard; prompt and response content is not retained in that cache. Each changed session is read in full before its numeric summary is cached by persistence revision. Very large logs can make the first load or a refresh slower. Unreadable sessions produce a visible partial-statistics warning. This is a token accounting view, not a billing or network bandwidth meter. Provider billing may use different accounting rules. ## FAQ ### Why is the dashboard empty? It only sees the session data source available to the current DSH profile. Complete a request in that profile, then refresh. Requests that are still streaming have not settled yet. ### Why do token totals differ from the provider's bill? The dashboard uses usage reported in local logs and has no access to billing adjustments or external requests. It does not estimate missing usage or calculate monetary costs. ### Why doesn't the chart match the selected summary period? The activity calendar always covers 52 weeks. The daily chart has its own 7–30 day window and displays input tokens only. The summary range applies to the headline metrics and rankings. ### How do I update or uninstall it? Replace or reinstall the plugin files, then restart DSH. Remove or disable the plugin through the DSH plugin manager to uninstall it. Session logs remain unchanged. ## Project structure ```text token-monitor/ ├── client.js # Dashboard, chart interactions, styles, and UI dictionaries ├── index.js # Read-only route and session summary cache ├── usage.js # Request deduplication and token aggregation ├── cordis.patch.yml # DSH bundle registration ├── icon.svg # Sidebar/plugin icon ├── locale/ # Plugin metadata translations ├── docs/images/ # Light and dark README previews ├── RE

# DBC CRUD Agent Skill

[简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

A structured command-line skill for creating, inspecting, updating, deleting, validating, and comparing CAN DBC databases, and for converting between DBC and Excel workbooks. It supports nodes, messages, signals, Classic CAN and CAN FD frame metadata, standard and extended multiplexing, JSON output, and deterministic node/message/signal comparison.

## Requirements and setup

- Python 3.9+
- The pinned dependencies in `requirements.txt` (`cantools==40.7.1`, `openpyxl==3.1.5`)

From the repository root:

```bash
python3 -m venv .venv
.venv/bin/python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
source .venv/bin/activate
```

Keep the repository layout intact when installing the skill: `SKILL.md`, `references/`, `examples/`, and `scripts/` use relative paths. Run commands from the repository root.

## Quick start

```bash
# Create and validate an empty database.
python3 scripts/dbc_crud.py --json init demo.dbc
python3 scripts/dbc_crud.py --json validate demo.dbc

# Add a node, a message, and a signal.
python3 scripts/dbc_crud.py --json node add demo.dbc ECU_A --comment "Body controller"
python3 scripts/dbc_crud.py --json message add demo.dbc 0x123 Status --length 8 --sender ECU_A
python3 scripts/dbc_crud.py --json signal add demo.dbc Status State --start 0 --length 8

# Inspect the result and validate again.
python3 scripts/dbc_crud.py --json signal show demo.dbc Status State
python3 scripts/dbc_crud.py --json summary demo.dbc
python3 scripts/dbc_crud.py --json validate demo.dbc
```

Message references accept a name or a decimal/`0x` hexadecimal frame ID. Put global options before the command, for example `python3 scripts/dbc_crud.py --json --encoding utf-8 summary demo.dbc`.

## Safe edits and normalization

- `node`, `message`, and `signal` add/update/delete operations save through cantools. An in-place save creates `PATH.bak` containing the original bytes by default; retain it while checking the result.
- `--output OTHER.dbc` writes a separate file and leaves the input unchanged. This is the safest choice for destructive or experimental edits.
- `--no-backup` disables the `.bak` copy for an in-place save. Use it only for disposable files or when another backup exists.
- Saving normalizes DBC text. It is not byte-for-byte lossless preservation of comments, formatting, or constructs that cantools does not model. The CLI writes a temporary file, reloads it strictly, checks all supported entity metadata, and then replaces the destination.
- The default encoding is UTF-8. Use global `--encoding` with the encoding used by the source and destination, such as `cp936` for a compatible legacy file.

## CAN and DBC capabilities

- Standard frame IDs: `0` through `0x7FF`; extended frame IDs: `0` through `0x1FFFFFFF` with `--extended`.
- Classic CAN message length: 1–8 bytes; CAN FD with `--fd`: 1–64 bytes.
- Standard multiplexing uses a root selector and branch values. Extended multiplexing supports nested selectors and multiple values/ranges through DBC `SG_MUL_VAL_` metadata.
- Signal bounds must both be present or both absent. Integer `0|0` is reserved for absent bounds; floating-point zero is representable. See the field reference before clearing or setting bounds.
- Comparison identifies nodes by name, messages by frame ID plus frame type, and signals by parent message identity plus signal name. Valid equal or different inputs return exit code 0.

## Excel conversion

```bash
python3 scripts/dbc_crud.py --json excel export INPUT.dbc OUTPUT.xlsx
python3 scripts/dbc_crud.py --json excel import INPUT.xlsx OUTPUT.dbc
```

- Export writes a five-sheet workbook (`Metadata`, `Nodes`, `Messages`, `Signals`, `Choices`) with dropdown validation for boolean and byte-order columns; an existing destination is replaced atomically without a backup.
- Import accepts only `.xlsx` files and rejects formula cells — paste computed cells as values before importing. The whole workbook is validated before anything is written, so a failed import never touches `OUTPUT.dbc`; a successful import replaces it atomically and `backup` is always `null`.
- Sheets beyond the five documented ones are ignored and listed in `result.warnings`.
- Verify a round trip semantically: export, import to a new DBC, then `compare` the two files and check `result.equal`.

The full workbook schema, column list, and cell syntax are in the [CLI reference](references/cli-reference.md#excel-conversion); result keys are in the [field reference](references/dbc-fields.md#excel-conversion-results).

## Documentation

- [Agent Skill](SKILL.md)
- [Complete CLI reference and real comparison JSON example](references/cli-reference.md)
- [DBC fields and validation rules](references/dbc-fields.md)
- [Complete English workflow](examples/workflow.md)
- [完整中文工作流](examples/workflow.zh-CN.md)

The workflows use a temporary copy and write every mutation to a new `--output` file. They demonstrate CRUD, scale editing, standard and extended multiplexing, safe deletion, comparison, a semantic Excel round trip, final inspection, and validation.

## Tests

```bash
.venv/bin/python -m unittest tests.test_docs -v
.venv/bin/python -m unittest discover -s tests -v
git diff --check
```

## License

Released under the [MIT License](LICENSE).

plugins.description: Runtime evidence that helps agents trace, profile, and burn down hotspots in application and native code, GPU kernels, and inference stacks.
plugins.readme_text:
flameox

Bounded local runtime evidence for coding agents.

Flameox coordinates profilers, benchmark tools, trace processors, and direct local targets. It turns an explicit artifact or command into bounded evidence while keeping durable preservation optional. The agent chooses hypotheses and experiments; Flameox records observed inputs, execution provenance, typed evidence, coverage, and limitations. There is no workspace to initialize or project configuration to maintain. Pass exact artifact paths to analysis and an explicit argv plus absolute working directory to capture. Flameox does not search parent directories, edit project files, or provide a hosted service. ## Quick start Configure an MCP client with the global setup command: ```console npx flameox@latest setup ``` Setup detects supported clients and asks which configurations to update. For automation, select clients explicitly, for example `--client codex --yes` or `--all --yes`; `--dry-run` reports the paths and actions without writing. Setup preserves unrelated client configuration and does not change project files. See [the npm package guide](npm/README.md) for details. Update existing MCP registrations with: ```console npx flameox@latest update ``` `update --check` reports available updates without changing configuration. Updates preserve each client's provider extras and settings, verify the new environment before changing release pins, and report which clients need a restart or reconnect. Use `--client codex` to select one client, or `--version 0.2.8` to select a specific release, including for rollback. The Python CLI exposes the same `flameox update` command. For direct CLI use, pass exact artifact paths or an explicit command: ```console uvx flameox analyze preview_artifact /absolute/path/to/artifact.json uvx flameox capture --provider direct --cwd "$PWD" -- python benchmark.py ``` To launch the stdio MCP server manually: ```console uvx flameox mcp serve ``` For local development, clone the repository, install its development dependencies, and inspect the available tools: ```console git clone https://github.com/morluto/flameox.git cd flameox uv sync --extra dev --extra memory --extra trace --extra cpu uv run flameox mcp inspect ``` ## Evidence and storage Analysis and unpreserved capture use bounded session scratch. Session `analysis_id` values expire when evicted or when the server stops. Explicit preservation creates the user-level Flameox data directory and stores native bytes and a canonical evidence bundle by SHA-256. Set `FLAMEOX_DATA_DIR` to choose another location. Preservation is optional; it does not imply full console-output retention. Flameox distinguishes observed, derived, and inferred claims. Profiles guide exploration but do not establish causality or performance improvement. Confirmatory claims require representative workloads, declared metrics and estimands, compatible identities, preserved samples, and a semantic oracle. ## MCP The MCP server has no workspace binding. It exposes named analysis and capture tools through the same operation registry as the CLI. Analysis tools accept explicit sources; capture tools accept a typed target and provider. Tool schemas expose operation-specific fields directly. Inspect the catalog with `flameox mcp inspect`; use `--tool TOOL_NAME` for focused schemas and examples. The complete contract and current tool catalog are in [the interface guide](docs/interfaces.md). Tools return their full bounded results inline, including failures and recovery actions. Preserved evidence has a durable `evidence_id`; `inspect_evidence` returns its redacted metadata and replay sources inline. Capture takes argv, not a shell string. A direct target supplies an absolute working directory and bounded environment overrides. Results may include `next_page`; replay its named analysis tool and arguments unchanged. Capture continuations read collected artifacts and do not rerun the target. MCP work belongs to the live request, so cancellation applies directly and no detached job survives a restart. ## Documentation - [Architecture](docs/architecture.md) describes process and package boundaries. - [Storage and evidence](docs/storage-and-evidence.md) defines preservation and provenance. - [Investigations](docs/investigations.md) covers experiments, comparison, and evidence quality. - [Adapters](docs/adapters.md) documents provider compatibility and integration policy. - [Runtime safety](docs/runtime-safety.md) covers limits, recovery, integrity, and privacy. - [Interfaces](docs/interfaces.md) defines CLI and MCP contracts. - [Testing](docs/testing.md) describes test selections and known proof gaps. ## Development Flameox requires Python 3.12 or newer and uses the committed `uv.lock`. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) for development setup and contribution guidance. ```console uv run ruff check src tests tools uv run ruff format --check src tests tools uv run mypy src tests tools uv run pytest -q ``` Flameox is licensed under the MIT License.

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin: dispatch work to DSH agents from Claude Code / Codex — native subagent progress, in-host worker sessions with per-tier presets, and a multimodal bridge that lends the text-only harness vision and image generation.
plugins.readme_text:
DSH Crew

A DeepSeek Harness plugin: dispatch work to DSH agents from Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity / Grok, without giving up the host's native subagent UI.
Native Progress UI • Tier Policy & Escalation • Dispatch Guardrails • Jobs Board • In-Host DSH Sessions • Vision & Image Gen (Native-First) • One-Click Install

npm: @zseven-w/dsh-crew · Current plugin release: 0.1.0-rc.11 · Tested with DSH 0.1.1-rc.1

English · 简体中文 · 繁體中文 · 日本語 · 한국어 · Français · Español · Deutsch · Português · Русский · हिन्दी · Türkçe · ไทย · Tiếng Việt · Bahasa Indonesia


The DSH Crew settings page — host integrations, dispatch policy, execution and the multimodal bridge

## Why DSH Crew DSH Crew is a plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) — an open-source agent harness. It makes DSH agents dispatchable from Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity and Grok: the orchestrator keeps its own model, the work runs on a real DSH agent with that harness's tools, sandbox, presets and session history, and the host still shows it as a native subagent with live progress. What runs the work is a DSH agent, not a bare model call. Tiers (`flash` / `pro`) select how much capability that agent gets from the harness's configured roster — DeepSeek V4 Flash and V4 Pro today — so a change of model in DSH needs no change here.
### 🧵 Native Progress UI Workers appear as regular subagents in Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity / Grok — dispatch count, running step, tool calls and token usage all show up in the host's own task panel, plus a claude-hud statusline segment: `⚙dsh 1▶pro 2m14s 21.7k/606 ✓3`. ### 🎚️ Tier Policy and Escalation `flash` for mechanical work, `pro` for reasoning, `effort` from `off` to `max`. `tier_policy` can clamp every dispatch to one tier at the tool layer, and `escalate_on_failure` retries a failed flash run once on pro — based on evidence, not on guessing difficulty up front.
### 🏛️ In-Host DSH Sessions With the bundle installed in a DSH profile, each worker is a first-class DSH session: visible in the Web UI, grouped by working directory, mounted with the Agent preset you choose per tier. Without DSH running, dispatch falls back to a standalone DSH runtime, so CI and headless environments still work. ### 👁️ Vision and Image Generation DSH's models are text-only. `describe_image` now prefers DeepSeek's own VL model (`deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp`) whenever a key is available, then falls back to the CLIs you already have — Claude, Codex, Grok, Antigravity — or any OpenAI-compatible API you configure. `generate_image` borrows the same CLIs' brush. Pasted images stay visible in the conversation and reach the model as text.
### 🛡️ Dispatch Guardrails Every dispatch is checked before anything spawns. Worker→worker nesting is capped at origin-chain depth 3 and cycles are refused; a second worker on a workspace another job already holds is refused with the holder's info — never silently queued. Refusals are readable errors: wait or re-scope, don't bypass. ### 📋 Jobs Board The DSH Crew panel doubles as a jobs board: every worker job — running or finished — is listed with tier, effort, live progress and tokens, held workspaces show their holders, and a job that vanishes mid-flight (e.g. a hub restart) is surfaced as an orphan ghost instead of disappearing silently.
### 🔌 Custom Providers Bring your own endpoint (Base URL + API key + models) or a local command template. Each provider has a connectivity test that checks reachability and auth, then makes one real vision call so you find out now, not mid-task. ### 📦 One-Click Install The settings page installs and updates the Claude Code plugin, the Codex role files and the Antigravity / Grok agents, skills and commands for you — marketplace registration, permission allowlist, HUD wiring, absolute paths rendered for this machine — and restores them just as easily. Every settings file is backed up first.
## How it works ``` Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity / Grok (orchestrator, keeps its own model) └─ ds-flash / ds-pro ← native subagent shell (progress shows in the host's task UI) └─ MCP: dsh_run_worker(tier, effort, cwd, worker=) ├─ worker="agy"/"grok" → that external CLI runs the task (explicit opt-in) ├─ hub reachable → session inside DSH (visible in the Web UI, grouped by cwd) └─ otherwise → dsh-jsonrpc-agent runtime (worker.cordis.yml) └─ DeepSeek V4 Flash / Pro (DSH SDK, event stream → progress and token stats) ``` ## One run, two views Dispatch fans out. Below, eighteen workers translate this README in parallel: the host counts them as its own subagents, while the harness runs them as real sessions.

Claude Code sees dsh-crew workers as native subagents, with a statusline segment tracking running tiers, elapsed time and tokens.

The DSH Crew panel sees the same run from the harness side: which host dispatched each job, its tier and effort, live progress and token usage.

The panel is also the jobs board: running and finished jobs stay listed with tier, progress and tokens, held workspaces name their holders, and a job that vanishes mid-flight (a hub restart) surfaces as an orphan ghost instead of disappearing silently.

## Install Install into a DSH profile from npm: ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add @zseven-w/dsh-crew@latest dsh web ``` Or, for local development straight from the source tree: ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add link:/path/to/dsh-crew dsh web ``` The `link:` protocol symlinks the profile dependency to this repository, so rebuilds are visible immediately. ### Configure DeepSeek credentials (standalone only) In hub mode — the installation above — workers run inside the DSH instance and use the DeepSeek credentials it is already configured with. Nothing else to set up. Only the standalone fallback needs a key of its own: dispatching from a host with no DSH instance running launches a worker runtime as a separate process. Obtain an API key from [platform.deepseek.com](https://platform.deepseek.com) and write it to `~/.config/dsh-crew/.env`: ``` DEEPSEEK_API_KEY=sk-... ``` ### Verify ```bash node scripts/smoke.mjs ``` The smoke test dispatches one cheap job through whichever path is available — the hub when a DSH instance is running, s

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness overlay showing OpenCode Go 5-hour, weekly and monthly usage.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-opencodego-status

A floating overlay for the **DeepSeek Harness Web UI** that shows your **OpenCode Go**
usage — the 5-hour rolling limit, the weekly limit and the monthly limit — at a glance.

![OpenCode Go usage overlay, collapsed pill](docs/pill.svg)

The collapsed pill lives in the corner of the window and shows the three percentages
with a colour dot per limit. Click it for progress bars, reset countdowns, the renewal
date, and the sign-in controls.

![OpenCode Go usage overlay, expanded card](docs/card.svg)

## What you get

- **Collapsed pill** — `5h · 7d · 30d` percentages, coloured by how close you are to the
  limit (brand → warning from 60% → error from 80%), plus the weekly reset countdown.
- **Expanded card** — one progress bar per limit, `resets in` and `renews in` countdowns,
  Refresh, Sign out, and a link to the OpenCode console.
- **Device-code sign-in** — connect from the overlay; the code is shown in the card and
  approved in the browser. No password is ever typed into the overlay.
- **Silent token refresh** — the stored session is refreshed before it expires.
- **English and Chinese UI**, following the Harness locale service.
- **Theme-aware** — every colour and border comes from the Harness theme tokens, so light
  and dark themes both look native.

The numbers come from the OpenCode Console Go subscription meters, the same source the
console page itself renders.

## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness Web UI (`0.2.x`).
- An **OpenCode Go** subscription. The overlay reads the Go plan meters; it shows
  `Not connected` when no OpenCode session is stored, and an error state when the
  subscription is missing or the API changes.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Assidefok/dsh-opencodego-status
```

Then refresh the Harness Web UI. A small pill appears in the top-right corner.

### Connect

1. Click the pill, then **Connect**.
2. The card shows a short code (for example `GNNM-XQHS`) and an **Open approval page**
   button. Approve the device in the browser.
3. The overlay switches to your live usage as soon as the console confirms.

The session is stored locally at `$DSH_HOME/opencodego-status/state.json` with `0600`
permissions (`$DSH_HOME` defaults to `~/.dsh`). **Sign out** in the card deletes it.
Tokens are sent only to `opencode.ai`; the browser half never receives them.

## Configuration

The bundle row in the Harness profile's `cordis.patch.yml` accepts:

```yaml
- id: opencodego-status
  name: dsh-opencodego-status
  config:
    enabled: true        # hide the overlay without uninstalling the bundle
    position: top-right  # top-right | top-left | bottom-right | bottom-left
    refreshSeconds: 60   # 15 – 3600
    showResets: true     # show reset countdowns
```

## How it works

- The **host half** (`index.js`) registers a prefix route at
  `/api/opencodego-status` and talks to the OpenCode Console:
  `<origin>/console/auth/device/code`, `<origin>/console/auth/device/token` (device
  grant and refresh grant) and `<origin>/console/api/go/status`.
- The **client half** (`client.js`) registers one entry in the `shell.overlay` slot and
  polls `/api/opencodego-status/status`. It never sees an access token.
- No dependencies, no build step: the client module is plain JavaScript and React comes
  from the Harness browser module table.

> The console endpoint is not a documented public API. If OpenCode changes it, the
> overlay degrades to an error state with a Retry button instead of breaking the UI.

## License

MIT — see [LICENSE](LICENSE).

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-ark-wiki

为 DSH 提供一个模型可调用的工具 `ark_wiki_lookup`：查询 PRTS Wiki 的《明日方舟》数据（干员及其技能/天赋/档案/密录、物品、关卡、剧情、干员出场表与「泰拉大典」世界观考据），返回结构化结果，由模型据此作答。

[![CI](https://github.com/wsk114514/dsh-ark-wiki/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/wsk114514/dsh-ark-wiki/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](./LICENSE)

> **目前的分发方式只有 GitHub 源码安装**：npm 尚未发布（2026 年的 2FA 政策，见 [RELEASING.md](RELEASING.md)），dsh-plugin.org 收录申请已提交、等待人工核实。

> **非官方粉丝项目**：与 Hypergryph（鹰角网络）、《明日方舟》官方及 PRTS Wiki 均无隶属关系；所有游戏数据与 wiki 文本的版权归原权利方，本项目仅做实时查询与展示，仅供个人非商业用途。详见[免责声明](#免责声明与权限)。

## 安装

### 方式一：从 GitHub 源码安装（当前可用）

```bash
# 1. 装到目标 profile（把 web 换成 desktop / 你实际使用的 profile 名）
dsh plugin --profile web add github:wsk114514/dsh-ark-wiki
# 2. 把包名 "dsh-ark-wiki" 写进该 profile package.json 的 dsh.profile.bundles 数组
```

### 方式二：npm

包**尚未发布到 npm**（npm 2026 年起要求发布者使用安全密钥 / 2FA，见 [RELEASING.md](RELEASING.md) 的「已知阻塞」一节）。发布后改为：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-ark-wiki
```

装完直接在对话里用自然语言提问，例如：

- 「阿米娅的属性、技能和天赋」
- 「至纯源石是干什么用的」
- 「1-7 的掉落和敌人」
- 「0-1 坍塌 行动前 有哪些台词」「12F 干员密录」
- 「克莱门莎最早在哪个剧情出场」（走干员出场表，返回按时间排序的完整登场列表）
- 「矿石病是什么」「维多利亚的首都」「整合运动」「泰拉年表」（走泰拉大典世界观检索）

## 安装（本地开发路径）

插件是标准 DSH bundle（`dsh.bundle.patch` 指向 `cordis.patch.yml`）。已实测可用的挂载方式：

```powershell
# A. 在 DSH 会话里用 plugin_manager 工具（推荐，自动完成 link + bundles 注册）
#    action: install_bundle
#    target: C:\path\to\dsh-ark-wiki
#    实测返回 {"stage":"enable","enabled":true,"changed":true,"application":"applied","warnings":[]}
#    并在 profile 里生成 node_modules\dsh-ark-wiki junction，
#    同时把 "dsh-ark-wiki" 追加进 profile package.json 的 dsh.profile.bundles。

# B. 命令行（real syntax，注意 --profile 是必需参数）
dsh plugin --profile desktop add C:\path\to\dsh-ark-wiki
# 等价于在 %DSH_HOME%\profiles\desktop 里执行 pnpm add <该路径>；之后仍需把包名加进
# 该 profile package.json 的 dsh.profile.bundles 数组（或由 plugin_manager 代劳）。
```

**开发期热重载**：插件是 junction 链入的，改完 `lib/*.js` 后不必重启 DSH——在会话里对 loader entryId 执行一次 disable → enable 即可让宿主重新 import 模块（实测 `{"application":"applied","warnings":[]}`，随后 `Tool/listTools` 立即出现新 schema）：

```jsonc
// plugin_manager, action: set_plugin, target 用 entryId 而不是包名
{ "action": "set_plugin", "target": "include:dsh-ark-wiki", "enabled": false }
{ "action": "set_plugin", "target": "include:dsh-ark-wiki", "enabled": true }
```

注意：`set_plugin` 传包名 `dsh-ark-wiki` 会返回 `{"application":"failed","error":{"code":"unknown-plugin"}}`，必须用 `include:<包名>`（可从 `plugin_manager` list_plugins 里查，或读 profile 的 `node_modules/<包名>/cordis.patch.yml` 中的 `id`）。

它依赖宿主注入的 `@deepseek-ai/cordis` 与 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools`（peerDependencies，宿主自行解析，插件不打包它们）。

## 工具契约

```jsonc
// 参数
{ "query": "阿米娅", "category": "operator" }   // category 可选：operator | item | stage | story | world
```

`category` 省略时按查询词自动判定：含「泰拉大典 / 世界观 / 考据 / 年表 / 词库」时先查泰拉大典；含「行动前 / 行动后 / 密录 / 剧情 / 序曲 / 出场 / 戏份 / 登场」或 `/BEG`、`/END` 时先当剧情查；形如 `1-7`、`S4-7`、`CE-5` 的代号先当关卡查；其余先查物品（仅接受完全同名），再查干员，然后关卡、剧情，最后泰拉大典。

剧情类别同时接受剧情页标题（`0-1 坍塌 行动前`）、章节/活动名（`黑暗时代·上`）与**干员名 + 出场**（`克莱门莎 出场`）；章节名返回 `candidates`（最多 8 条），模型可据此再查具体标题；干员出场会返回该干员在主线/活动/密录里的完整登场表。

世界观类别（`world`）覆盖 PRTS「泰拉大典」命名空间（143 页：角色/地理/组织/百科/生物/道具/剧情/关卡/成就/集成战略等）与附表 `泰拉年表`、`泰拉词库`、`泰拉文字`：先按页面标题精确/前缀匹配，再退到「泰拉大典」命名空间全文检索，解析其中的 `{{角色考据}}`/`{{地理考据}}`/`{{组织考据}}`/`{{种族考据}}`/`{{百科词条}}` 块；`泰拉词库` 另做译名对照（中文/英文/日文）。

返回值是一个 canonical JSON envelope（`output.schema` 已声明，`additionalProperties: false`）：

| 字段 | 含义 |
| --- | --- |
| `status` | `ok` / `not_found` / `error` |
| `category` | `operator` / `item` / `stage` / `story` / `world` / `unknown` |
| `query` | 原始查询词 |
| `matchedBy` | `exact` / `prefix` / `fuzzy` / `redirect` / `search` / `none` |
| `entry` | 命中条目的结构化数据（`type: 'json'` 节点，字段随类别而定） |
| `candidates` | 未命中时的近似条目建议（最多 8 条） |
| `message` | 给模型看的说明（模糊匹配、未找到、错误原因） |
| `source` | `{ endpoint, page }`，可回溯到 PRTS 页面 |

`render(args, value)` 把 envelope 渲染成 `[{ type: 'text', text }]` 的 Markdown 摘要；非精确命中会附「匹配说明」，末尾附 PRTS 来源链接。

`entry` 的主要字段（`entry.category` 表明类别，`entry.url` 指向 PRTS 页面）：

- `operator`：`name`、`aliases[]`（中/英/日其他名称）、`stars`、`profession`、`subProfession`、`position`、`tags[]`、`feature`、`nation`、`organization`、`team`、`race`、`sex`、`birthday`（如 `12月23日`）、`designer`、`painter`、`obtainMethod[]`、`releasedAt`、`id`、`index`、`page`
  - `skills[]`：`{ index, name, nameEn, nameJa, chargeType, triggerType, unlock, levels[] }`，`levels[]` 为 `{ level, description, initialSp, spCost, duration }`（`level` 形如 `1级`…`7级`、`专1`…`专3`）
  - `talents[]`：`{ slot, name, levels[] }`，`levels[]` 为 `{ condition, effect, potentialEffect }`（`condition` 如 `精英2 X模组3级`，`potentialEffect` 为满潜时的效果）
  - `buildingSkills[]`：`{ name, phase, level }`（基建技能）
  - `profile`：体检档案，`{ gender, combatExperience, birthplace, birthday, race, height, infectionStatus, infected, physicalStrength, mobility, endurance, tactics, combatSkill, artsAdaptability, cellFusionRate, crystalDensity }`（缺失字段省略；六维为「优良/标准/普通…」评级文本）
  - `archives[]`：`{ title, condition, text }`（基础档案、综合体检测试、客观履历、临床诊断分析、晋升记录等；`？？？` 占位段被过滤）
  - `records[]`：`{ set, index, page, url }`（干员密录：密录集名、第几话、PRTS 页面；`page` 可直接用 `category: story` 查台词）
- `item`：`name`、`itemId`、`rarity`（0 起算）、`rarityStars`、`kind`（分类）、`description`、`usage`、`obtain`、`page`
- `stage`：`code`、`name`、`type`、`subtype`、`difficulty`、`sanityCost`、`region`、`unlock`、`recommendedLevel`、`squadLimit`、`initialCost`、`costLimit`、`lifePoints`、`enemyCount`、`mapSize`、`fastestClear`、`drillCost`、`description`、`firstClearDrops[]`、`normalDrops[]`、`extraMateriel[]`、`reward`、`terrain`、`note`、`challenge{}`、`enemies[]`、`id`（游戏内部关卡 ID）、`story{}`（`{ before, after, extra? }`，每项 `{ title, page, url }`）、`page`
- `story`：`title`、`storyType`（主线/活动/干员密录…）、`storyGroup`（章节目录标题）、`chapter`、`kind`（`主线剧情`/`活动剧情`/`特殊剧情`/`干员密录`）、`textPath`（剧本资源路径）、`characters[]`（登场角色前 20）、`lineCount`、`truncated`、`lines[]`（最多 60 条，`{ speaker, text }`，`speaker` 为 null 表示旁白）、`operator`（干员密录所属干员）、`page`
  - 干员出场（`kind: '干员出场'`，来自剧情类别）：`operator`、`profession`、`rarity`、`total`、`counts`（`{ main, event, memory }`）、`earliest`（最早登场 `{ title, page, group, kind, date }`，`date` 可能为 null）、`appearances[]`（最多 48 条，`{ title, page, url, column, group, kind, date }`，按开放时间 → 主线章节顺序排序）、`truncated`、`source`
- `world`：`section`（人物考据/地理/组织/百科事典/生态调查/商品目录/剧情分析/附表…）、`title`、`summary`（正文首段，约 900 字）、`infobox`（地理页信息框键值，如 `{ 首都: '伦蒂尼姆' }`）、`details`（`{ 英文名, 日文名, 成员, 主要种族, 登场 }` 等模板参数，按页面可得性出现）、`sections[]`（小标题，最多 14 个）、`related[]`（`{ section, name, page, url }`，正文里的 `{{泰拉大典|…}}` 内链）、`terms[]`（`泰拉词库` 命中时为 `{ zh, en, other, ja, yostar, section }`）、`page`

掉落项形如 `{ name, condition }`（`condition` 为「固定掉落」「三星获得」等，可能为 null）；敌人项形如 `{ name, count, level }`。

## 免责声明与权限

- **非官方**：本项目是第三方粉丝工具，与上海鹰角网络科技有限公司（Hypergryph）、《明日方舟》官方运营方以及 PRTS Wiki 维护团队均无任何隶属或授权关系。
- **版权**：干员资料、剧情台词、物品描述等文本在运行时从 PRTS Wiki 实时读取，其版权归原权利方所有。本项目不打包、不分发、不缓存到磁盘；仅将单次查询结果交给当前对话中的模型用于回答。
- **用途**：仅供个人学习、研究与非商业查询使用。请遵守 PRTS Wiki 的访问规则，不要用本插件做批量抓取或高频轮询（插件内部有 10 分钟内存缓存与 8–12 秒超时）。
- **权限范围**：只读。仅通过 HTTPS 访问 `prts.wiki` 的公开 `api.php`；不读取本地文件、不读取任何凭据或环境变量、不上传对话内容、无遥测、无需 API Key。网络请求可通过宿主的 `AbortSignal` 取消。
- **风险**：查询结果依赖 PRTS 的页面模板结构（详见[已知限制](#已知限制)），PRTS 改版时相应字段会降级为空而不是编造数据；模型回答前应核对返回的 `source` 链接。

## 数据来源

全部走 PRTS 官方接口 `https://prts.wiki/api.php`，没有第三方爬虫或缓存服务：

1. **干员**：`ark-info` 包（`getOperators({ extraFields })`）→ 内部使用 MediaWiki Cargo `chara` / `chara_extra_info` / `char_obtain` 三张表。干员列表在进程内缓存 10 分钟，并按 zh/en/ja 名称建索引。
2. **技能 / 天赋**：PRTS **没有**这两类数据的 Cargo 表（`action=cargotables` 只返回 `building_skill2`、`char_building_skill`、`char_memory`、`char_mod`、`chara`、`chara_data`、`item`、`loot` 等），所以改为解析干员页 wikitext：`{{技能|…}}`/`{{技能2|…}}` 每个模板块一个技能（模板名的数字后缀随技能而变，**不是**槽位号），`{{天赋列表3|…}}` 里的 `天赋N`/`天赋N效果`/`天赋N条件` 与 `潜能增强_天赋N*`。基建技能另外走 Cargo `char_building_skill`（按 `_pageName` 过滤）。页面结果按干员缓存 10 分钟；页面取不到时静默降级为「只有基础档案」，不影响其余字段。
3. **物品**：Cargo `item` 表（`where: name LIKE '%关键词%'`）拿 `itemId`/`rarity`/`description`，再取页面 `{{道具信息}}` 模板补 `用途`/`获得方式`/`分类`（补全失败不影响主结果）。
4. **关卡**：直接按标题取页面正文，解析 `{{普通关卡信息}}` / `{{剿灭关卡信息}}` / `{{突袭关卡信息}}` / `{{敌方情报}}`；标题不存在时用 `action=query&list=search` 找候选页再解析前 3 个。命中后还会用剧情索引补出关联的「行动前 / 行动后」剧情链接。
5. **剧情**：PRTS 同样**没有**剧情 Cargo 表，所以分两条腿：① `Template:剧情导航`（约 146 KB）按表格行解析出 1700+ 条剧情页链接与所属章节/类型，得到「标题 → 页面」索引；② `char_memory` Cargo 表提供干员密录的 `storySetName/st

plugins.description: Version browser for installed DeepSeek Harness plugins: list published versions, switch or roll back, and uninstall from the Plugins page.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-versions

Version browser for **DeepSeek Harness** plugins. It adds an **Installed plugins** page under **Settings → Plugins** where you can see every published version of an installed plugin, switch to one, roll back, or uninstall it — all through the host's own `pluginManager` service.

English | [中文](./README.zh.md)

## Why

The official plugin manager intentionally has no version picker: third-party plugins are upgraded by uninstalling and reinstalling, and only official on-demand bundles get an explicit **Update** button. Pinning a known-good version, or returning to one after a regression, means editing `package.json` by hand.

This plugin adds exactly that missing surface, without replacing the market or the installer.

## Features

- Lists the bundles the current profile installs, with version, source spec, and whether the bundle is removable
- Expands a bundle into its full published version list from the registry (publish date, `latest`, deprecated flags)
- Switches version through `pluginManager.removeBundle` → `pluginManager.installBundle`, saving an exact dependency
- **Automatic rollback**: if the target version fails to install (peer gate, missing version, network), the previous version is installed back and the failure is reported
- Uninstalls a profile bundle from the same tab
- Works with the profile's configured registry (private registries included) and falls back to `registry.npmjs.org`

## Install

The npm package is not published yet, so install straight from this repository:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <name> add github:DangDangDeng/dsh-plugin-versions
```

or with an explicit Git URL:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <name> add git+https://github.com/DangDangDeng/dsh-plugin-versions.git
```

In DSH Desktop the `desktop` profile is managed by the application, so use **Plugins → Add plugin** and enter `github:DangDangDeng/dsh-plugin-versions` instead of the CLI. Restart or refresh the page afterwards. Add `#<tag>` or `#<commit>` to pin a revision.

Once published to npm, `dsh plugin add dsh-plugin-versions` will work as well.

## Use

1. Open **Settings → Plugins**.
2. Select the **Installed plugins** tab.
3. Expand a plugin to see its versions. The current one is tagged, and the newest is tagged `latest`.
4. **Switch** asks for confirmation, then removes and reinstalls the plugin at that version. A failure rolls back automatically.
5. **Uninstall** removes the bundle; its configuration is kept.

Refresh the page after a switch so the browser loads the other version's client half.

## How a switch works

```
pluginManager.listBundles()        find the installed bundle, remember its version
pluginManager.removeBundle(name)   unload + remove the dependency
pluginManager.installBundle(name@version, { saveExact: true, enabled: true })
   ├─ success → ChangeResult.application: applied | restart-required
   └─ failure → remove the half-installed package, install the previous version
```

`installBundle` refuses a package the profile already depends on (`already-installed`) in HMR profiles, which is why the removal is not optional. The host performs the same check before pnpm runs, so an incompatible peer range is reported without touching the profile.

## HTTP surface

The client half talks to the host half over one loopback-only route:

```
POST /plugin-versions/api/{list|versions|switch|remove}
```

Requests must carry `x-requested-with: XMLHttpRequest`, must not be `sec-fetch-site: cross-site`, and must arrive on a loopback `Host` (`127.0.0.1`, `localhost`, `::1`). Only bundles already installed in this profile can be switched or removed, so the route cannot be used as a general package installer.

## Limitations

- Loopback only: a page served with `--trusted-host` from another machine is refused.
- No automatic update check; this is a version browser, not an updater.
- Compatibility is not pre-checked per version — the host rejects an incompatible version and the switch rolls back.
- A switch needs `HMR` to apply live; without it the host reports `restart-required`.
- The page must be refreshed before the new version's client half runs.

## Development

Plain ESM, no build step:

```
index.js          host half: HTTP route + pluginManager calls
client.js         browser bundle: registers the Versions tab into plugins.tab
cordis.patch.yml  inserts the bundle row
locale/*.json     bundle title and description
```

Point the installer at this directory (`dsh plugin add <path>`, or **Add plugin** with an absolute path). The directory is linked, so edits take effect after a restart.

## License

MIT

plugins.description: Pi 扩展 + DSH bridge：把当前上下文镜像成普通文件，由模型自己删除 stale block。灵感来自 Facebook Research 的 CLM harness。
plugins.readme_text:
# oh-my-clm

可直接加载到 Pi 的精简 live-context 扩展，参考
[Facebook Research context-language-models](https://github.com/facebookresearch/context-language-models/tree/main/clm/clm_harness)
的“把当前上下文镜像到普通文件、由模型自行整理”思路。

**摘要**：扩展在 Pi 构建 projection 时把可编辑上下文镜像到 session 临时目录，由模型通过 `cleanup` 或同 call rewrite 整理；同一套核心实现同时服务 Pi 扩展与 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）/Cordis 插件。

**目录**

- [核心机制](#核心机制)
- [快速上手](#快速上手)
- [命令](#命令)
- [预算与生命周期](#预算与生命周期)
- [DSH 适配](#dsh-适配)
- [项目结构](#项目结构)
- [设计边界](#设计边界)
- [文档](#文档)
- [开发检查](#开发检查)
- [关键要点](#关键要点)

## 核心机制

Pi 为下一次请求构建当前 branch 的 projection 时，扩展会把可编辑部分镜像到当前 session 的临时目录：

```text
/tmp/clm-${sessionId}/LIVE_CTX_MAIN.md
```

`${sessionId}` 是运行时 session ID。多个 session 即使使用同一个工作目录，也不会共享或覆盖 mirror。旧版本生成的 `.pi/clm` 文件不会被自动迁移或删除。

### 模型如何整理历史

模型可以调用 Pi/DSH 都提供的 `cleanup({ blockIds: [...] })` 工具，按 editable block ID 删除 stale、重复或自指噪声。cleanup 在一次工具调用内完成 host-side 变更，不依赖完整 block body 或 `old_string`。需要缩短已有 block 时，rewrite 脚本要在同一个 host-side 工具调用内完成 read+write；普通 edit 只适用于完整且未截断的 body。DSH 会等触发文件编辑的 session event 发布完成后再应用 native replacement，所以脚本必须在工具返回前写完，不能在后台持续重写 mirror。

mirror 的结构如下：

```text
<!-- clm-v2 -->
<!-- CLM_SNAPSHOT ... -->

[[CLM_ENTRY id=1 role=assistant]]
这段旧内容可以被改写成一句更短的事实摘要。
[[/CLM_ENTRY id=1]]
```

### 编辑规则

- 只修改 block body；保留 `CLM_SNAPSHOT`、`CLM_ENTRY` 和 closing marker。
- `id` 是从 `1` 开始的可读编辑序号；不要改 ID，也不要重排 block。扩展内部仍用 Pi 的 opaque entry ID。
- 删除一个可编辑 block 会从后续 projection 中省略该消息；删除最后一个 block 时保留 `<!-- CLM_EMPTY -->`。
- 初始用户任务受到保护，不会出现在可编辑区域中；user-authored block 可以被省略，但不能被模型改写。
- Pi 侧的 mirror preview 有固定的单 block 和总大小上限；DSH 默认相同，但可用 `CLM_MAX_BLOCK_CHARS` / `CLM_MAX_MIRROR_CHARS` 覆盖。截断只影响显示，不改变 canonical source。
- `cleanup({ blockIds: [...] })` 按当前 1-based editable ID 删除 block；load-bearing block 1 始终保留，assistant/tool-result 配对也会整体处理。未知、重复、过期或协议损坏的 ID 会整体拒绝。
- 如果工具结果读取了 `LIVE_CTX_MAIN.md`，该结果会在未来 projection 中替换成短指针，避免 mirror 自我复制。
- 改写或删除 assistant tool turn 时，配对的 tool result 也会一起处理，避免孤立的 tool message。

### 索引与读取

DSH 的 runtime context 会包含 `<oh-my-clm-block-index>`，有两种模式（`CLM_INDEX_MODE`）：

- `digest`（默认）：每个已完成的 turn 一行，给出包含式 ID 区间、块数、估算 token 成本和该 turn 的第一条 user 消息；正在进行的 turn 只给稳定的起始锚点（`IDs N..`），不列出。正常追加时文本在一个 turn 内不变，DSH 只在 turn 边界追加一条快照，而不是每步一条；`cleanup`、mirror edit 或 compaction 会清空缓存并在同一 turn 内重渲染（见下文 DSH 配置项）。
- `blocks`（`CLM_INDEX_MODE=blocks`）：逐个列出可编辑 block，给出 cleanup 使用的 1-based ID、role 和短 preview。列表较长时显示前 12 个可编辑 block（“别动”锚点）加**最近 40 个**；两者之间的每个连续区间都用一行 `... N editable block(s) omitted (IDs A-B).` 标出，所以 ID 跳段不会被误读成空洞。

`cleanup` 接受 `ranges: ["3-16"]`（包含式区间）或 `blockIds: [...]`（单块），还可以用 `skipRoles: ["user"]` 在一个 turn 区间里保留人类消息。配对级联删除（assistant tool call 与结果）会单独报告为 `paired`，不会混进你请求的 ID。显式单块 ID 仍然严格校验，range 越界会夹取，range 覆盖 block 1 时保留 block 1。`cleanup({ list: "3-16" })` 是只读的展开：返回该区间的行（role + 短 preview），不做任何删除，因此“索引只给了省略行、但我想先看清楚”不需要读整个 mirror；它不能和删除目标同时出现。只有需要完整、未截断的正文做 rewrite 时才需要读 mirror。

### 分支与持久化

合法修改在 `turn_end` 通过 Pi 原生 `context_edit` 持久化；原始 session JSONL 不会被改写。

由于 context edit 属于当前 branch，`/tree`、fork 和 session resume 继续遵守 Pi 的分支语义。

## 快速上手

在仓库根目录运行：

```bash
pi --extension ./extensions/clm.ts
```

或以 Pi package 方式临时加载：

```bash
pi -e .
```

开始一项会产生几轮工具输出的任务。需要整理历史时，模型可以按 block ID 调用 `cleanup({ blockIds: [...] })`，也可以按系统提示对 `/tmp/clm-${sessionId}/LIVE_CTX_MAIN.md` 做同 call 的 rewrite/edit；手动压缩直接使用 Pi 原生 `/compact`。扩展不额外发送 “compact LLM turn”。

## 命令

```text
/clm
/clm status
/clm mode [blocks|digest|auto]   # 仅 DSH
```

`/clm` 与 `/clm status` 等价，Pi 扩展和 DSH 插件都提供。DSH 另有 `/clm mode`：不带参数显示当前模式，带 `blocks` / `digest` 则在当前进程里切换索引形状并清空缓存的索引文本，从下一步开始生效，直到进程重启；`auto` 撤销进程级覆盖、回到 `CLM_INDEX_MODE`（默认 `digest`）。这是进程级覆盖：切换会影响当前进程中的所有 session。进程环境只在启动时读取一次，所以这是不重启就做 A/B 验证的方式；要跨重启保持，使用 `CLM_INDEX_MODE`。

- **Pi 侧**显示 mirror 路径、字节数、可编辑/保护 block 数、preview/canonical 估算 token、Pi context usage、目标预算、shrink-only 策略和 branch 上已持久化的 context edit 数量。
- **DSH 侧**显示当前 session 的 mirror 路径、mirror 与 canonical projection 是否一致、字节数、可编辑/保护 block 数、preview/canonical token 估算、DSH surface 节点数、shrink-only 策略和 mirror 限制。命令只读，不修改 session、不写 mirror、不追加 session event，也不缓存状态，因此在第一次 bridge pass 之前也能给出准确结果。
- 两个宿主都不提供 `/clm refresh`。

扩展会在 session start 和请求前自动刷新 mirror；branch 切换只标记待刷新，真正的刷新发生在下一次 `context` hook 的 `syncMirror`。在 agent turn 之外直接修改 mirror，会在下一次同步时被恢复为 canonical projection，避免未经校验的内容进入 session。

## 预算与生命周期

### 预算与 nudge

`CLM_CONTEXT_BUDGET` 是一个近似的目标预算，不是第二个 context window，也不会阻止已经过大的请求。当估算 token 达到约 `0.75 × max(1, budget - 2048)` 时，扩展会在 `context` hook 返回一条临时 nudge，允许模型做一次 `cleanup` 或一次 mirror 编辑；该 nudge 不写入 session history。没有设置预算时不发送 nudge。

```bash
CLM_CONTEXT_BUDGET=32000 pi --extension ./extensions/clm.ts
```

超过 Pi 自身 context window 时，交给 Pi 原生 auto-compaction；需要手动整理时使用 Pi 原生 `/compact`。这避免在已经过大的完整上下文上再追加一次 `/clm-compact` LLM 请求。

### shrink-only 策略

所有接受的 mirror 编辑都采用固定的 shrink-only 策略：按 Pi 的结构化估算，编辑后的上下文必须严格短于编辑前。不能安全缩短上下文的编辑会被拒绝。系统 prompt 等 mirror 之外的固定 token 会计入预算估算。

### 显示上限

Pi 侧的 mirror 显示上限是固定的：单 block 约 `12000` 字符，总 mirror 约 `96000` 字符。DSH 默认使用相同值，但可用 `CLM_MAX_BLOCK_CHARS` / `CLM_MAX_MIRROR_CHARS` 覆盖。

### token 估算

token 计数使用共享格式层的 provider-independent `estimateMessageTokens(message)`，按消息分别估算。对当前 Pi 支持的 text、thinking、tool call、图片、system sections 和 tool declarations，它采用与 Pi host 一致的 `3.5 chars/token` 近似及 rounding。共享层不导入 Pi runtime，但会显式处理 DSH 的 `reasoning`、`tool-call`、`tool` 等形状；只有未识别的其他自有消息形状才走 fallback 估算。

当前 Pi extension 的公开 `ExtensionContext` 只提供 effective system prompt，`fixedRequestTokens` 因此只计该 prompt；tool declaration overhead 只有在 host 传入结构化 system message 时才会被计入，否则这个估算就不完整。它不是 provider 的精确 tokenizer；Pi/DSH 自身的 context window 仍是最终约束。

### mirror 文件位置与权限

生成的 `/tmp/clm-${sessionId}/LIVE_CTX_MAIN.md` 位于系统临时目录，不属于发布包，也不应提交到 Git。目录默认使用 `0700`，mirror 文件默认使用 `0600`；宿主仍负责临时文件清理和内容审计。

## DSH 适配

仓库同时提供一个最小 DSH/Cordis host bridge，契约依据官方
[`deepseek-harness`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/)（`master`）的 Cordis plugin、agent-loop、session projection 资料，并参考
[`dsh-ops`](https://github.com/T-Auto/dsh-ops) 的 Community v0.15 manifest 形态；它保留同一份
`src/features/live-context/context-format.ts` 镜像、解析、snapshot 和编辑规划实现。

### 契约与生命周期

- 社区插件发现入口是 [`dsh-plugin.json`](https://github.com/DevZjQx/oh-my-clm/blob/main/dsh-plugin.json)，host entry 为构建后的 `dist/dsh/index.js`；官方 bundle 安装元数据位于 `package.json` 的 `dsh.bundle.patch` 和 [`cordis.patch.yml`](https://github.com/DevZjQx/oh-my-clm/blob/main/cordis.patch.yml)。在 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 中，实际生效的是 bundle 元数据；`dsh-plugin.json` 的 Community permissions 目前不应被描述为运行时强制隔离。
- DSH 生命周期使用官方 Harness 的 Cordis `agent/created`、`agent/pre-step`、`session/event`、`systemPrompt.section()`、`systemPrompt.context()` 和 `tools.register()` 扩展点；cleanup 直接对当前 session surface 执行按 ID 的 native replacement，不读取 mirror 文件。
- `systemPrompt.context()` 负责把 block index 放进模型可见的 runtime context；DSH 自己的 runtime-context snapshot 也会从 mirror records 中排除，避免 index 递归列出自身。
- 普通 mirror 编辑的 `session/event` 只排队 reconcile；当编辑由 `tool/result` 或 `user/message` 触发时，mutation 在该事件的 `Session.append()` 发布完成后、当前仍打开的 step 内执行。`agent/pre-step` 不执行 mutation；它只在 session 仍有 open turn/step 时等待已排队的收敛，否则直接返回，把待处理编辑留给随后的 `step/start`。session projection 仍由 DSH 提供，session log 仍是事实来源。
- DSH 会按当前 session ID 生成 `/tmp/clm-${sessionId}/LIVE_CTX_MAIN.md`。系统提示给出 mirror 路径模板并说明可编辑（用于压缩），但删除操作明确指向 `cleanup`；runtime context 还会在 block index 上方给出一行 `Mirror:`，写的是当前 session 的具体路径——系统提示段是进程级静态文本，无法填 `<session-id>`。sandboxed bash 可能拥有不同的 `/tmp`，除非宿主显式共享该 session 目录。

### 编辑语义：与 Pi 的差异

bridge 会对 mirror 编辑执行与 Pi 侧相同的 snapshot、结构安全和 shrink-only 校验；合法编辑通过 DSH 原生 `Session.append()` 的 `surfaceOp: { op: "replace" }` seam 写入当前 session，处理后再把 mirror 重写为新的 canonical DSH projection。

当前 bridge 会改变 DSH active surface，这与 Pi 的 branch-local `context_edit` 不是一回事：cleanup 的删除计划全部是 `replacement: null`，因此只追加空 `developer/message` omission；普通 mirror 编辑在改写 tool result 时追加 `tool/result` content replacement，在改写/删除 assistant 时追加 `developer/message`（assistant 改写用缩短后的文本，删除用空 content）。原始事件仍保留在 append-only session log 中，`deriveMessages()` 使用新的 surface。

DSH 明确禁止 `assistant/message` 携带 `sourceEventSeqs`，而每个 replacement 又必须引用所有被遮蔽的节点，所以 assistant block 不能原地替换成另一个 assistant message。改写后的文本以 developer 身份进入模型可见历史，不再归属原模型回复。

它不生成 proposal/receipt 文件，也不注册自定义 session event；reconcile 在事件回调之外串行执行，避免 `Session.append(

plugins.readme_text:
# 字间 · Glyph Studio

## DSH 插件版

本项目是文字背景效果的独立编辑器，可调节文字、配色和动画参数。
用于 DeepSeek Harness 的版本见
[逍遥游 · Glyph Water 插件](https://github.com/Aimer779/dsh-xiaoyaoyou)。
插件仅在新建会话页显示背景，进入普通对话后自动关闭。
安装包与兼容版本见[插件发布页](https://github.com/Aimer779/dsh-xiaoyaoyou/releases)。
需要安装 DSH 插件时，请使用插件仓库；本仓库用于调参与效果开发。

可配置的本地文字背景工具。使用 Canvas 2D，无需安装依赖。

## 打开

用浏览器直接打开 `index.html`。
也可在此目录运行 `python -m http.server 8765 --bind 127.0.0.1`，
然后打开 http://127.0.0.1:8765 。

## 内容

- 内置《逍遥游》、ASCII、英文、日文四种预设。
- 在“内容”页编辑文字，点击“应用文字”更新背景。
- “排列方式”支持按输入顺序或随机打乱；两种模式均循环铺满网格。
- 随机排列保留字符及重复次数，不逐帧跳字。“重新打乱”生成新排列。
- 排列方式与随机种子随配置保存，刷新和导入后可恢复。
- 支持混合语言和组合字符，空白不占格，标点保留。
- Unicode 字形使用 `Intl.Segmenter` 分段，不拆分组合附标或 emoji 序列。
- 自定义内容最多 4000 个 UTF-16 代码单元、512 种字形，以限制图集内存。
- 衬线、无衬线、等宽字体使用系统字体；可显示字符取决于系统字体覆盖范围。
- 内容以固定网格逐字循环铺排，不是段落排版。

## 配色

“配色”页提供雾白、墨夜、青瓷、暮紫、暖砂预设。
每个预设只更改配色，保留内容与动画参数。

- 背景支持三色线性或径向渐变，以 Oklab 插值。
- 颜色可通过原生调色板或 HEX 输入设置。
- 线性渐变可调角度，径向渐变可调中心位置。
- 中间色位置可调，基础字色和点缀色独立设置。
- 点缀不再限制为蓝色，可用于任何深浅主题。
- 字体和字色更改时重建缓存图集；背景渐变变化不重建图集。

## 面板与配置

面板分为“内容、配色、波纹、背景、点缀、渲染”六页。
滑块与数字框实时同步；问号按钮展开参数说明。
标题栏可拖拽，位置自动保存；“归位”回到右上角。
拖拽手柄支持方向键微调。减号收起，加号展开。
标题、分类和底部操作固定，仅参数区域滚动。
下拉框使用原生 `appearance: base-select` 定制弹层与选项。
保留浏览器的方向键选择、确认、取消及边缘避让行为。
当前内置 Chromium 已验证；不支持该 CSS 的浏览器会使用自身下拉外观。
鼠标点击只改变边框；键盘导航使用细内描边，高对比度模式保留焦点提示。

完整配置包含文字、字体、配色和动画参数，自动保存在本浏览器。
文件地址与 HTTP 地址使用独立存储空间。
“更多”中可导出或导入 JSON；输入无效时拒绝应用。
“恢复默认”重置全部配置。动效预设只调整动画与渲染参数。

## 动效

字形坐标固定，明暗遮罩迁移形成游雾感。
点击留白触发波纹；面板中的“试一次波纹”触发单次预览。
“暂停动效”冻结所有动画。页面隐藏时暂停。
系统开启减少动态效果时显示静态背景。

点缀每轮在显现区域选择不规则的邻字簇：
簇数 0～12、每簇字数 1～12，3 字及以上不共线。
背景面积不足时簇数减少，每个生成簇保持设定字数。
点缀停留时间 0.8～4 秒，实际时长受动画速度倍率影响。
点缀强度为 0 关闭染色；较深波前保留基础字色。

## 实现与验证

- `content.js`：文字、配色预设，字形分段与渐变生成。
- `settings.js`：默认配置、参数范围、导入校验。
- `app.js`：字形图集、固定网格绘制、动画调度。
- `ambient.js`：游雾透明度场。
- `ripple.js`：波前与余波衰减。
- `tint.js`：局部点缀簇。
- `panel.js`、`appearance-panel.js`：调参、内容和配色界面。
- `panel-position.js`：面板拖拽和边界约束。

当前网格为 18×20 CSS px，字号 14px。图集缓存 17 级混合字色。
每字每帧只绘制一次，避免叠画改变透明度。
FPS 是动画回调频率，绘制耗时仅为 JavaScript 提交时间，不含 GPU 完成时间。

运行：

```powershell
node content.test.cjs
node ripple.test.cjs
node ambient.test.cjs
node tint.test.cjs
```

测试覆盖 Unicode 分段、文字与配色校验、配置往返、波纹、固定字形位置、
明暗连续变化、点缀数量与消退。浏览器交互另行检查。
