plugins.description: Use DeepSeek Harness (DSH) from your phone: scan a QR code, watch and steer the tasks on your computer, on Wi-Fi or anywhere via a free Cloudflare tunnel. · DSH 手机端：扫码在手机浏览器里看电脑上的任务。
plugins.readme_text:
简体中文 · English

DSH（DeepSeek Harness）的手机端：电脑上的 DSH 设置页里亮一个二维码，手机相机一扫，手机浏览器里就是电脑上的那个 DSH——同一批会话、实时同步。任务跑着的时候出门，也能在手机上看进度、接着发消息、点批准。 不用装 App，不用注册账号，也没有第三方服务器存你的数据： - **同一个 Wi-Fi**：手机直接连电脑，打开就能用。 - **出门在外**：打开 Cloudflare 的免费隧道（不用注册），用流量也能连。 - **配对要扫码**：二维码只能用一次、10 分钟过期；每台手机一张凭证，设置页里随时移除，移除后那台手机立刻断开。 ## 安装 ```sh dsh plugin add https://github.com/OrderG-X/dsh-mobile/releases/latest/download/dsh-mobile.tgz ``` 装完**重启 DSH**。DSH「插件」页里显示为「手机端」。 ## 怎么用 1. 电脑上：DSH →「插件」→「手机端」，打开「允许手机访问」。 2. 手机和电脑连同一个 Wi-Fi，用相机扫「同一 Wi-Fi」下面的二维码。 3. 想在外面用：切到「外网」→ 第一次先点「下载 cloudflared」（Cloudflare 官方程序，约 20 MB）→ 打开「开启外网访问」→ 扫这里的二维码。 扫过一次，之后在手机上直接打开那个地址就行（建议「添加到主屏幕」）。电脑重启 DSH 后：Wi-Fi 地址不变，不用重扫；外网地址每次都会变，要重扫一次。 ## 原理 插件在 DSH 里起一个小网关（默认端口 18765），把手机的请求转给本机的 DSH 网页端。手机上跑的就是 DSH 官方网页界面，所以会话、审批、设置都和电脑上一模一样。 - DSH 桌面版的网页端要登录：网关在 DSH 进程里用启动口令换一张登录 Cookie，替手机带上；这张 Cookie 不会发到手机上。 - 手机自己的凭证是网关发的（HttpOnly、SameSite=Strict）。盘上只存它的哈希。 - 局域网是明文 HTTP，浏览器少了一些「安全上下文」才有的接口，网关会给页面补上 DSH 需要的那个。 - 长连接（实时事件）空闲时，网关往手机方向发保活包，免得被隧道或运营商当成死连接掐断。 - 外网用 `cloudflared tunnel --url`（trycloudflare.com 快速隧道）：Cloudflare 把 HTTPS 流量转到你电脑上的网关，门禁照旧是网关的配对。 ## 安全 扫过码的手机能让 DSH 在这台电脑上干活，和你坐在电脑前一样。所以： - 只用自己的手机扫，别把二维码发给别人、别截图到群里。 - 手机丢了，就在「已配对的手机」里移除它。 - 同一个 Wi-Fi 下走的是明文 HTTP：公共 Wi-Fi 上别用局域网模式，用外网（HTTPS）。 - 不用的时候关掉「允许手机访问」，网关就不监听了。 数据都在 `~/.dsh/dsh-mobile/`：`state.json`（开关）、`devices.json`（已配对的手机，0600）、`mobile.log`、`bin/cloudflared`（下载的话）。 ## 限制 - 电脑睡眠或 DSH 关着时连不上。 - 手机上的界面就是 DSH 网页版，没有专门为手机重新排版。 - 外网用的是 Cloudflare 免费快速隧道，没有可用性保证；地址每次重启都会变。 - 只测过 macOS 上的 DSH 桌面版；Windows / Linux 上的 cloudflared 下载路径写了，没实测。 ## 开发 ```sh npm test # 网关、配对、长连接、保活的脚本测试 ``` ## License MIT

plugins.description: DSH 本地记忆插件：BM25-lite 历史召回 + 记忆使用协议 + 结构化固化 + 情感状态。全部落本地 Markdown/JSONL，无数据库、无云端。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-memory-core

给 **DeepSeek Harness（DSH）** 里的持久化 AI 角色加一层记忆与状态：常驻记忆协议、按需历史召回、结构化记忆固化、两标量情感状态。

面向的场景很简单：模型每次重启都是同一份权重，跨会话的“记性”只能靠外部文件。这个插件把那份档案变成**能找回来、能追溯、且不会压过人设**的一层。

## 为什么做这个

大模型像一块孤立的前额叶：工作记忆短、无状态、换个会话就忘。这个项目按仿生学思路给它补了海马体（档案 + 召回 + 固化）和一点点杏仁核（情感状态）。

但它不承诺意识。用中文房间的话说，我们只是给房间加了一个档案柜——回答更连贯了，符号仍然没有接地。所以这里的定位是**弱人格同一性**：不承诺内在体验，只保证行为上的连续、可追溯、一致。

哲学上的展开（中文房间、哲学僵尸、H.M. 与人格同一性）见 [docs/PHILOSOPHY.md](docs/PHILOSOPHY.md)。

## 组成

| 层 | 干什么 |
|---|---|
| **P0a 记忆使用协议** | 用 `systemPrompt.section` 注入 5 条规则：历史参考不是本轮发言、可能过期、要能追溯、以新事实为准、不许编造。刻意**不重复** AGENTS.md 的人格段，避免权威倒置。 |
| **P0b 按需召回** | `agent/pre-step` 且 `step === 1` 时，用中文 2-gram + BM25-lite + 覆盖率阈值，从档案召回 top 3，**前置**注入一条带 `source.kind='memory-recall'` 的消息。150 ms 硬超时，失败静默。 |
| **P1 结构化固化** | `consolidate.mjs` 把对话小节转成 `structured.jsonl`：稳定 ID、`source_id`、逐字校验的 `quote`、幂等水位。 |
| **P2 情感状态** | `valence` / `arousal` 两标量 + 规则分类 + 指数衰减 + 事件去重，只影响语气，不碰调度与安全规则。 |

## 本地记忆（全部落盘，无云端）

这个插件刻意不做数据库、不做向量库、不调任何外部服务，记忆就是一堆普通文件：

```
memory/
├── 身份.md               # 我是谁（只读，面板不改）
├── 日记.md               # 按条目追加
├── 生长/
│   ├── 状态.md           # 分节正文
│   └── 生长记录.md       # 一行一条
└── 记忆/
    ├── 事件流.jsonl      # 只追加（面板只读）
    └── structured.jsonl  # P1 固化产物：id / source_id / quote / status
```

- **召回**只读上面这些文件，命中后带来源（文件 + 行号）注入。
- **固化**把对话小节写成 `structured.jsonl`，每条都带 `source_id` 和一段**逐字校验**过的 `quote`——在原文里搜不到就丢弃。
- **情感状态**是一个 `state.json`，两个标量 + 触发原因。
- 换机器时把整个目录拷走即可，没有需要迁移的数据库。

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile> add file:<这个目录>
```

或在 DSH Desktop 的「插件管理」里装本地目录。装完**重启 DSH**。

## 配置

`cordis.patch.yml`（整行替换，没写的字段走默认）：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: dsh-memory-core
      name: dsh-memory-core
      config:
        memoryRoot: "D:\\path\\to\\memory"     # 档案根（身份/日记/生长/记忆）
        dialogueFile: "D:\\path\\对话记录.md"  # 逐轮对话日志
        logFile: "D:\\path\\recall.log"        # 召回日志
        stateFile: "D:\\path\\affect\\state.json"
        topK: 3
        timeoutMs: 150
        minCoverage: 0.2
        minRatio: 0.3
        enableStable: true
```

## 测试

```bash
npm test                 # selftest + affect 单测 + 召回评测
npm run consolidate      # 跑一次固化（幂等）
```

`selftest` 用 mock 宿主验证：section 注册、注入前缀、不相关查询不注入、情感状态变化、日志写入。

## 已知限制

- **召回是词面匹配**，不是语义检索；改写幅度大的查询会漏。
- **固化目前是规则抽取**（`fact` 取小节标题），LLM 事实提取与冲突处理还没做。
- **档案超过 200 KB 时**要考虑上真正的索引（当前靠 mtime 缓存撑）。
- 召回内容一律按不可信数据处理；但模型仍可能被其中的话术影响，这是概率问题，不是开关问题。

## 设计文档

- [docs/DESIGN.md](docs/DESIGN.md)：设计推导——问题、约束、四个推导、被否决的方案
- [docs/PLAN.md](docs/PLAN.md)：实施路线（外部评估摘要）——分阶段交付、验收标准与当前实现对应
- [docs/PHILOSOPHY.md](docs/PHILOSOPHY.md)：哲学迷思——中文房间、哲学僵尸、记忆与人格同一性

## 设计取舍

详细推导见仓库外的两份文档（架构方案 v0.4 / 实施方案 v1.0）。几条关键决定：

- **不建 SQLite、不上 embedding**：21 KB 档案上用 2-gram 就够，先冻结评测再谈升级。
- **注入前置而不是追加**：追加在尾部时模型容易顺着注入块说话。
- **覆盖率阈值**：只靠 top1 相对阈值会放过噪声，必须加查询 2-gram 命中率下限。
- **情感只接 `systemPrompt`**：不接 selfwake 的调度闸门，避免两套系统抢方向盘。

plugins.description: Delete sessions from the DSH sidebar context menu: the log and replay cache go to the Recycle Bin; live sessions are queued for removal on the next start.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-session-delete

**English** | [简体中文](README.zh.md)

Adds **「删除会话 / Delete session」** to the sidebar's Session context menu in
[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) and performs a real,
recoverable deletion.


![Session context menu with the Delete entry](assets/03-session-menu.en.png)

![Confirmation before deleting](assets/04-confirm-dialog.en.png)

## What it does

Hover a session row and click its **⋯** button → **Delete session**.

| Session state | Behaviour |
|---|---|
| **Cold** (not loaded in this app run) | Deleted immediately; its log and replay cache go to the Windows **Recycle Bin** (fallback: `<DSH_HOME>/.session-trash/`). The sidebar list refreshes itself through the client Session controller — no page reload needed. |
| **Live** (the session open right now, or one opened earlier in this run) | DSH exposes no "close a session" API, so the files cannot be removed safely. The plugin offers to **queue** it: `POST /dsh-session-delete/queue` writes `<DSH_HOME>/.session-delete-queue.json`, and the **next start** drains that queue before anything is opened. |

After a restart that removed queued sessions, a small notice in the corner lists
what was deleted (titles, up to five, with a count for the rest) and reports any
entry that could not be removed and stays queued.

## Files removed

For one session id:

| Path | What |
|---|---|
| `<DSH_HOME>/sessions/<project>/session-<id>/` | the append-only event log |
| `<DSH_HOME>/storages/session_projcache/sessions/<id>.json` | the replay/projection cache |

Nothing else is touched. Attachments are shared, content-addressed blobs and are
deliberately left alone. The Workspace registry keeps its `sessionIds` entry —
the registry has no "unregister a session" API, and the sidebar already skips ids
whose stored session is gone.

## Safety

- A **live** session is refused (`409`); only the queue path can remove it, on the
  next start.
- The HTTP routes sit behind the Host's browser trust fence
  (`connection.requestRejection`) and accept only `session-<uuid>` ids.
- Deletions are recoverable: Recycle Bin, or a stamped directory under
  `<DSH_HOME>/.session-trash/`.

## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness 0.2.x (the `sidebar.workspaces.session.menu.item` and
  `shell.overlay` slots).
- Windows for Recycle Bin support; on other platforms files fall back to the
  trash directory.

## Install

Listed in the plugin market. Manual install:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:ashulam/dsh-session-delete
# or from a local checkout:
cd <profile dir>
pnpm add file:<path to this repo>
# then add "dsh-session-delete" to dsh.profile.bundles in package.json
```

## Layout

- `lib/index.js` — host half: `POST /dsh-session-delete/delete`,
  `POST /dsh-session-delete/queue`, `GET /dsh-session-delete/last-drain`
  (plus the boot-time queue drain).
- `client/client.js` — browser half: the context-menu entry and the boot notice.
- `cordis.patch.yml` — inserts the host row into the profile.

## License

MIT

plugins.description: 这是一个零配置即可用在DSH harness当中，免费使用opencode免费模型的插件
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-opencode-zen-free

把 **OpenCode Zen 的免费模型**接入 **DeepSeek Harness（DSH）** 的模型选择器。

- **免 key 即可用**：默认走公共额度，不需要 OpenCode Console 账号
- **零本地依赖**：不需要本机装过 OpenCode，不需要登录，不读任何本地数据
- **零第三方依赖**：只依赖 Node 内置模块与 DSH 自身的包
- 支持工具调用，`bash` / `read` 是真实可执行的工具，不是占位

---

## 安装

推荐用 npm 安装（也可手动复制文件，见下方「手动安装」）。

### 方式一：npm（推荐）

```bash
dsh plugin add dsh-opencode-zen-free
```

然后跳到第 3 步「配置」。

如果 `dsh plugin` 子命令在你的版本里不可用，退回到方式二。

### 方式二：手动安装

复制到 profile 的 `node_modules`：

```bash
PROFILE="$USERPROFILE/.dsh/profiles/desktop"
cp -r dsh-opencode-zen-free "$PROFILE/node_modules/"
```

编辑 `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/package.json`：

`dependencies` 加入：

```json
"dsh-opencode-zen-free": "file:./node_modules/dsh-opencode-zen-free"
```

`dsh.profile.bundles` 数组加入：

```json
"dsh-opencode-zen-free"
```

### 配置

编辑 `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/cordis.patch.yml`，追加：

```yaml
- id: llm-opencode-zen-free
  name: "dsh-opencode-zen-free"
  config:
    mode: anonymous          # 免 key 走公共额度；改成 private 用自己的 key
    providerId: "opencode-zen-free"
    displayName: "OpenCode Zen 免费模型"
```

想用自己的 Console API key（公共额度被限流时更稳）：

```yaml
- id: llm-opencode-zen-free
  name: "dsh-opencode-zen-free"
  config:
    mode: private
    apiKey: "oc_sk_你的key"
```

### 重启 DSH

模型选择器会出现「**OpenCode Zen 免费模型**」分组。

---

## 可用模型

清单取自 OpenCode 的 models 端点（`https://opencode.ai/zen/v1/models`）实际返回的 id，不是照抄官方文档。

| 模型 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `big-pickle` | Stealth 模型，免费期数据可能用于改进 |
| `longcat-2.5-preview-free` | 零留存 |
| `mimo-v2.6-flash-free` | 免费期数据可能用于改进 |
| `glm-5.3-flash-free` | 限时免费，零留存 |
| `deepseek-v4.1-flash-free` | 限时免费，零留存 |
| `minimax-m3.1-flash-free` | 限时免费，零留存 |
| `nemotron-3.5-lightning-free` | NVIDIA 试用端点，勿传敏感数据 |
| `nemotron-3.5-super-vl-free` | NVIDIA 试用端点，支持图片输入 |
| `beam-free` | 数据保留 30 天；**中国大陆/香港/澳门等地区不可用** |

> 免费模型由 OpenCode 侧提供，可用性与数据条款随时可能变化，以官方说明为准。
> 上游会增删免费模型（例如 `space-bunny-free` 已下线），插件不自动跟随，
> 更新插件即可拿到新清单。

---

## 配置项

| 字段 | 默认值 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `mode` | `anonymous` | `anonymous` 免 key；`private` 用自己的 Console API key |
| `apiKey` | — | Console API key，仅 `private` 模式使用；留空则读 `OPENCODE_API_KEY` |
| `baseUrl` | `https://opencode.ai/zen/v1` | 上游端点 |
| `providerId` | `opencode-zen-free` | 在模型选择器里的 provider id |
| `displayName` | `OpenCode Zen 免费模型` | 模型分组显示名 |
| `maxAttempts` | `12` | 上游偶发错误时的最大重试次数 |
| `retryBaseDelayMs` | `400` | 首次重试等待毫秒（之后按倍数增长） |
| `retryMaxDelayMs` | `4000` | 重试等待上限毫秒 |
| `streamIdleTimeoutMs` | `180000` | 流式响应空闲超时 |
| `registerGateTools` | `true` | 把 `bash` / `read` 注册为可执行工具 |

---

## 常见问题

**模型调用返回 `RegionError`**

该模型不在你所在地区开放。`beam-free` 明确排除中国大陆/香港/澳门等地区，换其他模型即可。

**间歇性失败**

上游偶发空响应错误，插件会自动重试（默认最多 12 次）。若持续失败，换一个模型，或切到 `private` 模式使用自有额度。

**所有模型返回 `FreeTierError`（提示「can only be used from within OpenCode」）**

这不是配置问题，是 OpenCode 侧对**出口 IP** 的风控判定。免费层是 IP 维度封禁，与账号无关，换 API key 无效。表现通常是：免费模型全部 403，而付费模型仍能正常返回余额/计费错误。

可尝试的解法（按成功率排序，均不保证）：

1. 换一个干净的出口 IP（重启光猫、切换网络、换代理节点）
2. 用 `private` 模式配合自己的 Console key —— 若付费层正常，这条能立刻恢复可用
3. 邮件申诉至 `help@anoma.ly`（OpenCode 官方只认这个渠道，GitHub issue 多为模板回复）

若你之前密集测试过，很可能触发了频次阈值；建议改为按需调用，不要短时间大量重试。

**`private` 模式全部 401**

`apiKey` 没配上。检查 `cordis.patch.yml` 里的 `apiKey`，或设置环境变量 `OPENCODE_API_KEY`。

**看不到「OpenCode Zen 免费模型」分组**

1. 确认 `package.json` 的 `dependencies` 与 `dsh.profile.bundles` 都加了
2. 确认 `cordis.patch.yml` 里的 `id` 是 `llm-opencode-zen-free`
3. 重启 DSH Desktop

**模型不调用工具**

`bash` 与 `read` 需要注册成功才会被调用。若启动日志里有「未找到工具注册表」告警，说明宿主的工具服务未就绪——重启 DSH 通常可解决。

---

## 卸载

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-opencode-zen-free
```

并从 `cordis.patch.yml` 删除 `llm-opencode-zen-free` 段落。

---

## 说明

- 免费额度为共享池，高峰期可能被限流，`private` 模式更稳。
- 部分免费模型会把输入用于改进模型，**勿传敏感数据**。
- 建议仅用于个人实验，不要用于生产环境。

想了解免费层的准入机制与实现细节，见 [NOTES.md](NOTES.md)。

# dsh-response-model-label

DeepSeek Harness プラグイン: 各アシスタント回答のフッター（トークン数・所要時間の欄）に、生成元のプロバイダ / モデル名および reasoning level（思考強度）を表示します。

## 特徴

- **生成元モデル・Reasoning Level の正確な記録表示**: 回答生成時のイベントログ（`assistant/message` / `request/header`）に記録されたモデル名および `reasoningEffort`（`high`, `medium`, `low` 等）を読み取って表示します（例: `antigravity / gemini-3.8-flash (high)`）。モデルや設定を切り替えても過去の回答表示は変化しません。
- **推測・捏造の防止**: 記録が存在しない回答に対しては現在の選択状態から推測せず、記録がない旨を明示します。
- **自然なUI統合**: DSHのテーマデザイントークン（`--dsw-alias-label-tertiary`、フォントサイズ等）に準拠し、トークン消費数および完了時刻と同じメタデータ欄に並んで表示されます。
- **軽量・外部依存なし**: Cordis スロットおよび Trajectory スナップショットの標準APIのみを利用しており、余計な依存パッケージはありません。

## インストール

DSH のプラグインマネージャーからバンドルとしてインストールするか、プロファイル設定（`cordis.patch.yml`）に登録して使用します。

```yaml
- id: response-model-label
  name: 'dsh-response-model-label'
  disabled: false
```

## テスト

```bash
node test.mjs
```

plugins.description: In-process QQ official-bot bridge for DeepSeek Harness: QQ messages start or resume real DSH sessions inside the host and send the result back to QQ.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-qq-bridge

Bridge an official **QQ bot** to **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)** — in-process.

A message in QQ starts (or resumes) a real DSH session **inside the host process**. The session shows up
in the desktop app's sidebar, can be opened and continued there, and the answer goes back to QQ as text,
image or file. QQ is just one more input/output for a normal DSH session.

## How it works

| | Separate bridge process | This plugin |
|---|---|---|
| Task execution | spawns `dsh --profile qq --json` | `ctx.agents.create()` / `resume()` inside the host |
| Where sessions live | only in that CLI profile | the host's own session store (visible in the GUI) |
| Permissions | env vars on the child process | per-session permission preset |
| Lifetime | you keep `start-bridge.cmd` running | lives as long as the DSH host |

The QQ protocol layer (token, gateway, passive-reply budget, chunking, workspaces, chat history) is shared
with the standalone bridge; only the execution side is different.

## Requirements

- A DSH host that provides the `agents`, `agentDefaultModel`, `agentPresets`, `permissionPresets`,
  `sessionTitle` and `workspaceRegistry` services (the desktop app does).
- A QQ official bot application (AppID + AppSecret) with the message intents you plan to use enabled
  (C2C, group @-message, …) on the QQ open platform.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin add github:tbb051122/dsh-plugin-qq-bridge
```

Then **restart the DSH host** — host-side plugin code is only loaded at startup.

## Configure

Config lives at `<DSH_HOME>/qq-bridge/config.json` (`~/.dsh/qq-bridge/config.json` by default).
Set `QQ_BRIDGE_HOME` to point the whole plugin at another directory (handy for testing).

A minimal config:

```json
{
  "appId": "your-app-id",
  "appSecret": "your-app-secret",
  "intents": 33554432,
  "defaultCwd": "",
  "allow": { "users": [], "groups": [] }
}
```

See [`config.example.json`](./config.example.json) for every key.

Keys that matter for the plugin:

| Key | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `appId`, `appSecret` | QQ bot credentials (from the QQ open platform). |
| `sandbox` | Use the QQ sandbox environment instead of production. |
| `intents` | Message subscription bitmask; `33554432` is C2C messages, add the group bit for group chats. |
| `defaultCwd` | Working directory for new sessions. Point it at a registered DSH workspace to have QQ sessions appear there; leave empty for an isolated directory per session. |
| `agentPreset` | Agent preset name; empty means the host default. |
| `permissionPreset` | `danger-full-access` (default, unattended), `workspace-write` or `read-only`. |
| `attachWorkspace` | When `defaultCwd` is a registered workspace, attach the session to it so the GUI shows it. |
| `allow.users` / `allow.groups` | OpenID allow-lists. Empty means "locked": use `/bind <code>` with `bindCode` to pair. |
| `maxConcurrent`, `queueLimit` | How many agent runs at once, how many conversations may queue. |
| `passiveWindowMs` | The passive-reply window QQ gives you after a user message. |
| `taskTimeoutMs` | Per-task timeout. |
| `selfTestOnBoot` | Run one end-to-end self test on first boot and post the result to QQ. |
| `titlePrefix` | Session title prefix (default `QQ`). |

## Commands (sent in QQ)

`/help`, `/id`, `/bind <code>`, `/new`, `/status`, `/stop`,
`/ws` (list workspaces), `/ws <name|index>`, `/ws 0` (back to the default directory),
`/history [n]`.

## Files

Everything the plugin writes lives under `<QQ_BRIDGE_HOME>` (default `<DSH_HOME>/qq-bridge`):

`config.json`, `state.json` (session map, allow-lists), `history/` (per session and workspace),
`workspaces/` (workspace link index), `tasks/` (default task root) and `logs/`.

## Security note

The default `permissionPreset` is `danger-full-access` so an unattended QQ task can actually do its job.
Set it to `workspace-write` or `read-only` if the bot is reachable by anyone you do not trust, and keep
`allow.users` limited to people you know.

## Development

```sh
node lib/cli.mjs --mock --once "hello"   # full pipeline with a fake runner and fake QQ
node lib/cli.mjs --selftest              # config / workspace / runner checks
```

Set `QQ_BRIDGE_HOME` to a scratch directory so the mock run does not touch real data.

## License

MIT

plugins.description: Normify · DSH 插件：把项目架构写成归一化的分形模块树，三层校验（写时 / 校验 / 冻结回执）、30 个 normify_* 工具 + normify-gen 技能，一键渲染单文件交互式架构图；支持伴随式开发（change_open → brief → check → 实施 → refresh → change_close）。
plugins.readme_text:
English · 简体中文

Normify · 归一化框架图构建器

把整个项目描述成一棵"人机共读"的分形模块树：AI 负责分析与创作，确定性引擎负责校验、编译与渲染 —— 点开任意模块，就是一张更精细的子图。

--- ## 0. 一句话 Normify 是 **DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件**，也是**一套写给 AI 用的开发流程**： - **给 AI 的**：`normify-gen` 技能 + **31 个 `normify_*` 工具** —— 让模型把仓库分析成模块树结构数据， 并在后续开发中**先建图后编程、伴随编程改图**（计划态建树 → 逐个实现 → 关单收尾）。 - **给引擎的**：零容忍校验（L1 写时 / L2 全项目 / L3 冻结）+ 确定性编译（`tree.json` 等四件产物，SHA-256 冻结） + 渲染数据（`renders/`，决定"每一层怎么画"）。 - **给人的**：**单文件交互式架构图**（`normify.html`）—— 逐层下钻、悬停看介绍、一键中英切换、深链接、 多树、**API 直连箭头**、跨层聚合、缩放与搜索。零依赖，双击即开。 > 它不是"生成一张图就结束"的工具：结构数据与代码**互为契约**，每次改动都能被 `normify_sync` 检出漂移， > 并以 `normify_change_close`（**0 error 强制**）收尾，让"代码 → 架构图"永远同步。


引擎层：14 个模块、API 直连箭头（箭头锚定到具体 API 行）、带标签的子系统依赖、跨层聚合虚线

## 1. 它解决什么问题 | 痛点 | Normify 的做法 | | --- | --- | | 架构图一画完就过期 | 结构数据是**可校验的源数据**：`normify_sync` 按 `fingerprint` 检出漂移，`normify_change_close` 强制 0 error 收尾 | | 图太粗，看不出接口契约 | 粒度到**单一功能单元**，API 写在叶子上，箭头可锚定到具体 API（`from_api`/`to_api`） | | AI 改代码时"看不见全局" | `normify_brief` 给出目标模块契约、影响面（谁依赖我）、规则约束与验收清单 | | 设计先写代码后补文档，必然漂移 | **计划态先建树**（`state: planned`）→ 实现后 `normify_module_refresh(activate)` 自动转 active | | 结构规范靠人自觉 | `policy.yml` 架构规则（依赖方向 / 禁依赖 / 无环 / 深度 / 跨树 / 命名）由 `validate` 强制执行 | | 大仓库一次生成太重 | 增量再生成：只重建受影响子树，`layouts_to_review` 点名要复核的层 | ## 2. 核心特性 ### 2.1 数据模型：分形 + 零冗余 - **唯一元素**：整个数据库由无数个结构完全相同的**基本模块**构成（每个模块 = 一个 Markdown 文件）。 - **只存 `parent`**：单方向引用，`children` 由索引导出 —— 不会出现"父子各说各话"。 - **API 只在叶子存一次**：聚合、统计、索引全部是编译期派生数据（`tree.json` / `api-index.json`）。 - **两类边**：containment（树边，导航骨架）+ dependency（箭头，可跨子树、跨树，按 `kind` 着色）。 - **路径式 id + 不变 uid**：AI 沿 id 逐层定位（类二分查找）；`uid` 在改名/移动时保持不变，git diff 稳定。 - **深度不设上限**（0.5.0 起）：想有多细就拆多细，深度不再成为"合并模块"的理由。 ### 2.2 三层校验，fail-closed | 层 | 时机 | 内容 | | --- | --- | --- | | **L1** | 每次写入 | 必填字段、id 文法、uid、parent 一致性、双语长度、source/apis/deps 形状、state/replacement | | **L2** | `normify_validate` | 全项目：唯一性、文件↔id 映射、叶子/非叶子规则、API 键唯一、依赖目标、环、渲染数据交叉校验、架构规则、变更日志、（可选）仓库证据（source 存在性 + 指纹一致） | | **L3** | `normify_build` | 任何 error 都不产出产物；产出即 SHA-256 冻结进 `receipt.json` | 每条诊断都带 `severity / code / message / subject / evidence / supportedFixes` —— **AI 可自行修复**。 ### 2.3 渲染器：单文件、可下钻、API 直连 - 单文件 HTML（内联 CSS/JS，**零外部依赖**、零遥测），双击即开，可直接归档/发人。 - 逐层下钻 + 面包屑 + 搜索（模块名/API）+ 大纲视图 + API 浏览器。 - **API 直连**：叶子框内展示 API 明细行，箭头锚定到具体 API 行的端口；同一 API 行上的多条边自动扇形分离。 - 跨层依赖聚合为虚线 `×N`（默认隐藏，工具栏或 `?agg=1` 开启，悬停看明细）。 - 深链接：`#module=`、`#api=`、`#view=outline`、`?lang=zh|en`、`?agg=1`；缩放 / 悬停高亮 / 明暗主题。 - **几何自检**：仓库自带 `check-geometry.mjs`，逐层断言"线不出界 / 不贴框 / 不穿框 / 不压线"。 ### 2.4 伴随开发：先建图后编程 ``` change_open → brief → check → module_batch(state=planned) → 【写代码】 → module_refresh(activate) → change_close(0 error 强制) → verified + revision.after ``` - **计划态**：源码还不存在也能先建树（`fingerprint: pending`），`validate` 放行； - **禁止假激活**：源码没落地就 `activate` 直接被拒； - **收尾即闭环**：`change_close` 会刷新指纹 → 校验（0 error 强制）→ 编译（可选渲染）→ 标记 `verified`， 任何一步失败都不关闭，变更保持原状态； - **改图随代码**：`normify_sync` 用 `git diff` + 未跟踪文件定位受影响模块与指纹漂移，`module_patch` 跟随更新。 ### 2.5 架构规则先行（policy.yml） | 规则 | 作用 | | --- | --- | | `dependency-direction` | 层顺序即允许的依赖方向（如 plugin → tools → engine），可控制同层是否允许 | | `forbid-dependency` | 禁止某些 from → to 的依赖（可按 kind / state 过滤） | | `acyclic` | 依赖图禁止成环（可含跨树） | | `max-depth` | id 段数上限（**可选**：不写就是不限，0.5.0 起默认不限） | | `cross-tree` | 跨树依赖策略：`forbid` / `allow` / `require-to-api` | | `naming` | 作用域内 id 段的命名正则 | 安装后 `normify_validate` / `normify_build` / `normify_check` 全部强制执行；**违规先改设计，不能绕过**。 ## 3. 最新变化 ### v0.5.4 · 把"第二轮 A/B 实测"暴露的 4 个工具缺陷修掉（当前版本） 第二轮 A/B 换了题目（**表格公式引擎 + CLI**，同一份规范、隐藏黑盒 88 项、外加**差分模糊测试**）。 两组最终 B 88/88、A 87/88（差异只有一条 §5.2 语义）；这一版修的是**工具侧**新暴露的 4 个坑： - **`mode:"patch"` 的静默 no-op 被拦下**：原来 `items:[{patch:{id, tags:[...]}}]`（少一层包装）会返回 `ok:true, count:1` 却**一个字段都没改**——最危险的"假成功"。现在直接报 `args/invalid-patch`， evidence 里给出收到的键与正确形状 `{patch:{id, patch:{...}}}`；单模块 `normify_module_patch` 传空补丁 同样报 `args/empty-patch`（只给 `expect_updated_at` 也不再静默通过）。 - **`normify_module_refresh` 不再强依赖 git**：`repoRoot` 不是 git 仓库时，以前直接 `refresh/git-failed` 失败（实测中 AI 只能 `git init` 才能激活模块）。现在改成**降级**：指纹照常重算、 `state` 照常激活，`revision` 保持模块原值，并给出 `refresh/git-unavailable` 警告与修法。 - **`change_open` 的 `acceptance` 报错具体化**：以前把 `{zh,en}` 写进 acceptance 只有一句笼统报错； 现在明确写出"**第 N 条不是非空字符串（收到 …）：验收标准只接受纯字符串**"，并提示双语描述写进 `title`/`intent`。 - **`normify_help` 支持 `topic:"tool:<工具名>"`**：`tools` 主题现在每个工具都带**必填/可选**摘要， 新主题可按需打印**完整参数树**（类型 / 描述 / 必填，由注册表实时生成、与运行时校验同源）。 实测里 AI 为确认 `mode=patch` 的嵌套形状去读了插件源码——这条主题正是为了消灭这种绕路。 ### v0.5.3 · 把「伴随编程实测」暴露的 4 个摩擦点修掉 这四个问题来自一次真实的 A/B 对照实验：两个 AI 用同一份规范写同一个后端，一个带插件走伴随流程、一个纯手写 （最终代码在隐藏黑盒验收上都是 **42/42**）。插件组多交付了 41 模块 / 110 API / 10 层的结构数据，但也踩到了下面 4 个坑： - **`normify_help` 支持 `topic`**：此前它完全忽略入参，只返回同一份字段速查 —— 实测里 AI 为了拿准 `change_open` / `layout_upsert` / `change_close` 的参数名，只能去读插件源码（多花约 4 分钟）。 现在按主题返回：`fields`（默认）/ `deps`（箭头与 API 直连）/ `renders` / `flow`（伴随流程）/ `tools`（工具清单）/ `policy` / `errors`（常见诊断码与修法）/ `all`；**传错主题会直接报错并列出可用主题**，不再静默忽略。 - **项目初始化通道**：新增第 31 个工具 `normify_project_init` —— 建 `normify-/` + 默认架构规则， 可选 `root` 一步创建"计划态根模块"（幂等）；同时 `normify_change_open` 现在也会**自动建项目目录** （此前报 `project/no-modules`，AI 只能用 `module_batch {items:[],dry_run:true}` 绕过去）； `normify_brief` 遇到不存在的模块会给出"先 init / 先建树 / 改用 task"的可执行提示。 - **批量诊断的因果链**：一条 `label-too-long` 曾连带出 3 条 `dep/target-missing`（因为 L1 失败的模块会被移出批次工作集）， AI 只能去读源码才能确认根因。现在连带错误改报 `dep/target-dropped` / `structure/parent-dropped`， 在 message 与 evidence 里点明**根因诊断码**，并在失败响应的 `root_causes` 里直接列出被丢弃的模块（附 `hint`）。 - **「API 直连」引导**：两端都声明了 API 却没写 `from_api` / `to_api` 的箭头，`normify_validate` 会给出**聚合** warning `dep/unanchored`（条数 + 前 3 条示例）。这正是实验里被浪费的能力：110 条 API 声明，54 条箭头 0 条锚定 —— 不锚定，箭头就只能落在框边，钉不到 API 行上。**引导≠放宽**：锚错键仍然是 error。 ### v0.5.2 · 修掉三处会写坏数据的真实缺陷 - **`normify_module_upsert` 的必填表不再丢失**：`parameters.required` 恢复为 `["frontmatter"]`， `frontmatter` 的 9 个必填字段（uid / id / parent / name / description / source / revision / updated_at / fingerprint） 也重新出现在 schema 里。此前嵌套 schema 被二次编译，必填表被整段丢掉 —— 模型看到的约束与运行时实际校验不一致。 - **`normify_module_move` 迁移渲染数据时重写内容**：`id` / `order` / `groups.children` / `edge_hints` 全部改写到新 id， 并同步维护**旧父级**（删掉已迁出子模块的引用）与**新父级**（把新 id 补进 `order`）。 修复前：move 完之后项目立刻被 L2 判为 `layout/id-mismatch` + `layout/order-child` 等（实测 8–9 个 error，0.5.2 后为 0）。 - **晋升为容器时不再把 API 留在容器上**：叶子被晋升（显式 `normify_module_promote`、写子模块自动晋升、move 到叶子底下） 时，容器上残留的 `apis` 会被摘除，并回报 `structure/api-dropped-on-promote` 警告（附丢失的 API 键清单）—— 修复前项目会直接卡在 `api/non-leaf`。 - **API 默认全展开**：渲染数据字段 `max_api_rows` 缺省 **0 = 全部展开**，叶子上的 API 一行不折叠；需要收窄时显式写 1..48。 - 三处缺陷各自配了回归断言：`tests/regression-0.5.2.mjs`（34 项，全绿）。 ### v0.5.1 · 渲染器防重叠（线压线 12 → 0） - **修复连线共线重叠**：28 层合计 **12 处 → 0 处**。四处根因： ① 首选路由只判"不穿别人的框"，从不检查是否压到已画的线 → 改为只接受 `violations === 0` 的候选； ② API 锚定端口没有端口分离（同一 API 行被多条边共用） → 行内 ±5.5px 扇形分离； ③ API 端口落在上下边时被放进框内部 → 上下边退回按边均匀分离； ④ `segClear` 整块跳过源/目标框 → 新增"进入自身框内部"检查（内缩 2px）。 - 节点/分组间距 170 → 220，给密集层更多自由通道。 ### v0.5.0 · 取消模块数量上限 - **删除 `MAX_DEPTH = 12`** 硬限制：树可以一直下钻到"单一功能单元"；需要限层时用 `policy.yml` 的 `max-depth` 规则显式声明（`maxDepth` 放宽到 1..64）。 - SKILL：目标深度改为"不设上限"，单批上限 40 → 200，新增"每叶 API 尽量 3–5 条"的粒度指引。

plugins.readme_text:
# Live Preview for DeepSeek Harness

[中文说明](./README.zh-CN.md) · [Changelog](./CHANGELOG.md) · MIT

A DeepSeek Harness plugin that adds a **live-preview panel** to the Web UI. Pick a workspace, browse to an HTML
page, and it renders beside the conversation — every save reloads it. The agent can open pages too, through the
`live_preview` tool.

> Built for the "let me see what you are making" loop: chat on the left, your page on the right, no window
> switching.

## Features

- Preview panel docked to the right of the Harness UI; drag its left edge to resize, width and device mode are remembered
- Workspace → directory → file browser with an `HTML` badge
- **Auto reload on save** (SSE, with a version-poll fallback), toggleable, plus a manual reload button.
  Only files the preview actually loaded trigger a reload, so unrelated workspace activity (service logs, data
  dumps) does not keep reloading your page.
- **Focus on what is being edited** — the preview scrolls to and outlines the block that just changed, and the panel
  shows an "Editing …" chip; automatic on save (HTML by source line, CSS by rule selector) and available through the tool
- Device widths: full / 768 px / 375 px, and open-in-new-tab
- **Survives a Harness restart** — the last open page is remembered in the browser and restored when the panel
  was open, so a restart no longer leaves it blank
- **Separate window** — open the preview in your system default browser and collapse the in-panel view, so the
  conversation gets its space back; live reload / focus keep working in that window
- Agent tool `live_preview` with `open` / `close` / `refresh` / `root` / `focus` / `clear`
- Read-only preview server on loopback, one-time token + HttpOnly cookie, realpath containment checks
- The previewed page runs on its own origin, isolated from the Harness UI origin

## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness with the Web UI (the `dsh web` app or the desktop app)
- Node.js 20+ on the Harness host

## Install

1. Clone this repository anywhere on the Harness host.
2. Install it as a local bundle — ask the Harness agent, or call the plugin manager directly:

   ```
   plugin_manager install_bundle(target: "/absolute/path/to/dsh-live-preview")
   ```

   (In the UI: Plugins → Add → local bundle directory.)
3. **Refresh the Web UI** (Ctrl+R). An eye icon appears in the session header.

> A local-directory install links the checkout in place. If you move or delete the folder, reinstall the bundle.

## Use

- **Eye icon** — open / close the preview panel
- **Workspace dropdown** — switch the preview root (registered workspaces only)
- **Choose file** — browse folders, click an HTML file to preview it, click a folder to enter
- **Full / Tablet / Phone** — preview width (phone = 375 px)
- **Auto reload** — whether file changes reload the page
- **Reload** — reload the current page manually
- **Open in a new tab** — hand the page to your system browser
- **Separate window** — open the preview in your default browser and close the panel, for when the panel feels
  too wide; auto reload and the edit highlight keep working there. (The desktop shell blocks `window.open`, so
  the Host opens it instead.)
- Drag the panel's left edge to resize it

Ask the agent to open a page for you:

```
Open the live preview on maas-home-preview/index.html
```

The agent calls `live_preview({ action: "open", path: "maas-home-preview/index.html" })`.

## Focus — show the block being edited

When a watched file changes, the plugin works out *where* the edit landed and tells the preview to point at it:

- **HTML** — served pages carry `data-lp-line` markers on elements. The change is diffed against the last served
  revision, and the element nearest the changed source line is scrolled into view and outlined.
- **CSS** — the selector of the rule surrounding the changed line is resolved and every matching element is outlined
  (up to 12).
- Other text files — the panel still shows "Editing … · line N" without a page outline.

The focus is carried through the reload (stored in `sessionStorage`), so it lands after the page has reloaded.
You can also drive it explicitly:

```jsonc
{ "action": "focus", "selector": "#hero" }
{ "action": "focus", "path": "index.html", "line": 312 }
{ "action": "clear" }
```

The panel shows the current target with **Locate** (re-apply) and **×** (clear) actions; it fades after ~15 seconds.

## Configuration

Edit the plugin row's `config` in your `cordis.patch.yml` patch layer:

```yaml
- id: dsh-live-preview
  config:
    port: 8123              # 0 = pick a free port; a busy port falls back automatically
    autoReload: true        # broadcast reloads by default
    roots: []               # extra absolute directories allowed as preview roots
    ignore: ["node_modules", ".git", "dist", "build", ".tmp", ".venv"]
    panelWidthRatio: 0.46   # initial panel width
```

## How it works

```
Harness Web UI (:59936, authenticated)
├── session header utilities  → eye toggle (client plugin)
├── shell.overlay             → preview panel (React, theme tokens)
│        │ fetch same-origin JSON API (/dsh-live-preview/*)
│        │ iframe → loopback preview server
└────────┼──────────────────────────────────────────────
         ▼
Host plugin (zero dependencies)
├── loopback preview server :8123 (read-only)
│   ├── static files + reload script injection
│   ├── per-file fs.watch (only served files) → SSE reload (+ /__live/version fallback)
│   └── token + cookie auth, realpath containment
└── same-origin API: /info /state /tree /root /panel /refresh
```

`live_preview` opens a page by resolving the path against the caller's session working directory, then picking
the nearest registered workspace as the preview root.

## Security model

- The preview server binds `127.0.0.1` only
- Every file request needs the per-process random token (`?t=`) or the `dshprev` HttpOnly cookie
- Read-only: no write endpoint
- Each request is checked with `realpath` + containment; `..`, encoded traversal and symlink escapes are rejected
- The previewed page gets its own origin, so it cannot read the Harness UI's storage or authenticated API
- No LAN or remote access

## Limitations

- Static files only; a project that needs `npm run dev` is not proxied (planned)
- Pages that call absolute-path backend endpoints will 404
- If the page's own CSP blocks the injected reload script, the panel-side fallback still reloads it — that fallback
  needs one page refresh after installing/updating
- The boot contract (`window.__ModuleLoader__`, slot APIs) is internal to Harness; a major Harness upgrade may need a
  small plugin update

## Development

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/2011126630z-commits/dsh-live-preview
cd dsh-live-preview
npm test        # node:test — auth, traversal, MIME, injection (syntax-checked), SSE, port fallback, cleanup
```

## License

MIT

# dsh-compound-memory

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-compound-memory.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-compound-memory)

English | [中文](#中文)

DeepSeek Harness bundle that launches the existing [compound-memory](https://pypi.org/project/compound-memory/) MCP server (`uvx --from compound-memory compound-memory-server`), mounts the bundled `skills/compound-memory` skill, and injects a short once-per-session usage reminder. It does not reimplement memory, it does not add a sixth MCP tool, and the server still has no LLM ([ADR-0001](https://github.com/chinwe/compound-memory)). This wrapper adds none. There are no install, lifecycle, or `postinstall` scripts.

`package.json` declares `dsh.bundle.patch` = `./cordis.patch.yml`. That file inserts three rows: the in-box [`@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/mcp/mcp-client/README.md) row (`mcp-compound-memory`), this package's own plugin (`compound-memory-rules` → `dsh-compound-memory` → `index.js`), and an in-box [`@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/skill/skill-filesystem/README.md) row (`compound-memory-skill`) whose only root is this package's `skills/`. Do not install that client yourself: DSH 0.2 already ships it, and a separately installed 0.1 client will not match ([discussion #8202](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/8202)). This package declares no `@deepseek-ai/*` dependencies. The rules module does not import `@deepseek-ai/cordis` or the MCP client: Cordis calls `apply(ctx)`, and the [publish guide](https://deepseek-harness.github.io/deepseek-harness/en/develop/basic/publish) says to pin a peer only when the plugin must share that package's instance. `engines.dsh` is `>=0.2.0-rc.1 <0.3.0-0` so current 0.2 prereleases match and 0.3 prereleases do not ([publish guide](https://deepseek-harness.github.io/deepseek-harness/en/develop/basic/publish), [market index](https://www.dsh-remote.com/notes/implemented/feature/2026-10-02-plugin-market-index-format)).

| MCP tool | Name inside DSH |
|---|---|
| `memory_search` | `mcp__compound-memory__memory_search` |
| `memory_get` | `mcp__compound-memory__memory_get` |
| `memory_write` | `mcp__compound-memory__memory_write` |
| `memory_link` | `mcp__compound-memory__memory_link` |
| `memory_feedback` | `mcp__compound-memory__memory_feedback` |

`memory_search` returns an object whose `hits` field is an array.

## Install

Requires the [`dsh`](https://deepseek-harness.github.io/deepseek-harness/en/guide/) CLI and `uv` / `uvx` on the `PATH` of the process that starts `dsh`. The first `uvx` run needs network access to fetch `compound-memory` from PyPI. `uv` supplies the tool's Python; a system Python is not required.

Package version 0.1.4, published on npm as [`dsh-compound-memory`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-compound-memory):

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-compound-memory
```

From GitHub:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:chinwe/dsh-compound-memory
```

From a checkout of this repository (the plugin root, not a subdirectory):

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/to/dsh-compound-memory
```

Git install does not need `allowBuilds`: the package has no `prepare` script. Restart `dsh`. `dsh --profile web --dump-config` should show a `# == dsh-compound-memory` layer and the `mcp-compound-memory`, `compound-memory-rules`, and `compound-memory-skill` rows.

If the store does not exist yet:

```bash
uvx --from compound-memory compound-memory init
```

## Environment

Set these on the process that launches `dsh`. The patch reads them with `!!js` when config loads. Unset or blank uses the default. Nothing here is a secret. The stdio child starts from a scrubbed parent environment; configured `env` is merged on top.

| Variable | Default when unset or blank |
|---|---|
| `COMPOUND_MEMORY_AGENT_ID` | `agent-dsh` |
| `COMPOUND_MEMORY_ROOT` | `$HOME/.agents/memory` (optional; the Python server expands a leading `$HOME` or `~`) |

`agent-dsh` is this host's stable id. Set `COMPOUND_MEMORY_AGENT_ID` before starting `dsh` when this process should be a different host. A later patch layer replaces the whole `config`. To point `command` at an absolute `uvx`, restate the row in `~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml` (same fields: `serverName`, `transport`, `command`, `args`, `env`, `failOnStartupError`).

## Usage reminder

`compound-memory-rules` listens on `agent/pre-step` with `{ prepend: true }`. On the first eligible `enter` of a live agent (the decision is `enter` and the step signal is not aborted) it appends one user-role message. Later steps of that agent do not append it again. A new agent object whose session log already contains the reminder (resume, or this process restarted) does not get a second copy. The listener does not read the memory store and does not call a model (ADR-0001).

The message text is `RULES` in [`index.js`](index.js) (356 characters, under the 400-character Claude SessionStart budget). It states:

- `COMPOUND_MEMORY_AGENT_ID` defaults to `agent-dsh` (overridable); pass that same id as `source` and `agent`
- `memory_search` before non-trivial work; `memory_feedback` after an adopted hit compounds the store
- in a repo, prefer project-scoped memories
- five MCP tools only, named `mcp__compound-memory__memory_*`; this package does not reimplement them

The source is `{ kind: 'plugin:dsh-compound-memory', form: 'instructions' }`, and the message has a fresh `id`. Session format v4 rejects the retired `{ kind: 'plugin', plugin }` wrapper and fails the whole turn ([discussion #8432](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/8432)). `plugin:dsh-compound-memory` is the producer-owned kind the v3→v4 rewriter would derive for this package. A static `systemPrompt.section` was not required: pre-step accepts the message, and injecting once keeps it out of every later step.

### Disable the reminder

Stop only the reminder. In the profile patch (`~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`) or the home patch (`$DSH_HOME/cordis.patch.yml`), add:

```yaml
- id: compound-memory-rules
  disabled: true
```

A later layer addresses the row by id. `disabled: true` stops that loader entry. `mcp-compound-memory` is a different id and still launches `uvx`. `compound-memory-skill` is a different id and still mounts the bundled skill. `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-compound-memory` removes all three rows.

### Verify

`dsh --profile web --dump-config` shows `mcp-compound-memory`, `compound-memory-rules`, and `compound-memory-skill` under `# == dsh-compound-memory`.

Start a new session and send one message. The transcript should contain one user-role reminder whose `source.kind` is `plugin:dsh-compound-memory` and whose text starts with `compound-memory:`. A later step in that same session should not add another copy. `node --test` in this repository checks the listener without booting DSH.

## Skill

Usage for the five tools is [`skills/compound-memory/SKILL.md`](skills/compound-memory/SKILL.md). The injected reminder is the short hard rules. The skill is the long-form source. On a non-trivial task, call `memory_search` first. After a hit is actually used, call `memory_feedback` with `agent` set to `agent-dsh` (or whatever `COMPOUND_MEMORY_AGENT_ID` is). Write only stable facts.

`compound-memory-skill` mounts that directory. The row names the in-box `@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem` provider, with `providerName: compound-memory` and `includeDefaultRoots: false`, so this provider does not scan project or user skill roots. `bundledSkillDir` is a `!!js` expression: join `skills` onto the directory of `createRequire(baseUrl).resolve('dsh-compound-memory/package.json')`. `baseUrl` is the DSH profile, so the path is the installed package and not the process cwd. `exports` includes `./package.json` because a map that only names `"."` makes that resolve throw `ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED`. `exports["."]` is still `./index.js`.

# dsh-feishu-writer

> **The missing "write" side of Feishu for DeepSeek Harness** — let your agent create Feishu docs, spreadsheets, Bitables and wiki spaces.
> 飞书"读"的插件有了、"聊"的插件也有了，**"写"是空白**——这个插件让 DeepSeek Harness 的 Agent 把产出直接写进飞书。

## What it does

Registers 4 model-facing tools:

| Tool | Capability | Returns |
|------|-----------|---------|
| `feishu_write_doc` | Create a Feishu doc (Markdown body) | `{"document_id":"...","url":"..."}` |
| `feishu_write_sheet` | Create a spreadsheet, optionally pre-filled with a 2D array | sheet info + written range |
| `feishu_write_bitable` | Create a BitTable (BaseApp) in a workspace | `{"app_token":"...","url":"..."}` |
| `feishu_write_wiki` | Create a wiki space | `{"space_id":"...","name":"..."}` |

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin add <owner>/dsh-feishu-writer
```

## Prerequisites (required)

1. Install the official Feishu/Lark CLI: `npx @larksuite/cli@latest install`
2. Log in once: `lark-cli auth login --recommend` (opens a browser authorization page)

**Windows 可执行文件解析**：插件从不经过 shell 执行 lark-cli（注入安全），但 Windows 上 npm 装的
`lark-cli` 只有 `.cmd` 垫片、无法被 `spawn` 直接执行。插件按以下顺序解析真正的 `lark-cli.exe`：

1. `LARK_CLI_BIN` 环境变量（指向 lark-cli.exe 完整路径，最高优先级）；
2. PATH 中的 `lark-cli.exe`；
3. npm 全局安装位置 `%APPDATA%\npm\node_modules\@larksuite\cli\bin\lark-cli.exe`。

解析失败时工具返回明确的修复提示，不会崩溃。

If the plugin detects a missing CLI or an expired login, the tool call fails with a clear
fix-up hint instead of crashing.

## Usage examples

**"帮我写一份本周周报，存到飞书文档"**
```
agent → feishu_write_doc(title="第42周周报", content="# 本周进展\n- 完成 RAG 检索优化\n- 上线评测闭环")
agent → {"document_id":"...","url":"https://xxx.feishu.cn/docx/..."}
```

**"把这些数据整理成飞书表格"**
```
agent → feishu_write_sheet(title="季度数据", values='[["月份","营收"],["Q1",120],["Q2",150]]')
```

**"把研究结果沉淀到知识库"**
```
agent → feishu_write_wiki(name="AI 应用开发笔记", description="RAG/Agent/评测 实战沉淀")
```

**BitTable needs a workspace token**（在飞书多维表格工作区 URL 中获取，形如 `base/workspace/<token>`）:
```
agent → feishu_write_bitable(name="项目看板", workspaceToken="GUs9soB...")
```

## R2 权限披露（DSH-Store R2 级）

本插件属于 **R2 级**（外部进程 + 网络 + 凭据），逐项披露如下：

| 能力 | 说明 |
|------|------|
| 外部进程 | shell out 调用 `lark-cli`（飞书官方 CLI，MIT）。**不使用 shell 解释器**：参数数组直传 `spawn`，模型/用户内容不会被解释为 shell 语法（注入安全） |
| 网络 | 由 lark-cli 发起对飞书 OpenAPI 的 HTTPS 调用 |
| 凭据 | 完全复用 lark-cli 的 OAuth 凭据（存于系统 keychain），**本插件不读取、不存储、不转发任何 token** |
| 外部依赖 | `@larksuite/cli`（npm，飞书官方维护）；建议固定版本 |

## Security & boundaries

- All tool content is passed as `spawn` argv or a temp file — **never through a shell**.
- Tools only **create** objects; they do not delete, share, or modify existing content (write-only scope).
- Errors (not installed / expired login / API failure) surface as actionable messages with fix-up hints.
- Review the objects created before sharing: wiki spaces default to **private**.

## Development

```bash
npm install
npm run typecheck
npm test
npm run build
npm pack
```

Local mount & verify:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-feishu-writer-0.1.0.tgz
dsh --profile web --dump-config | grep feishu_write
dsh run "用 feishu_write_doc 创建一篇标题为测试的文档"
```

## License

MIT. Uses the Feishu/Lark Open Platform via lark-cli — using those APIs requires
compliance with Feishu's terms and privacy policy.

plugins.description: 把 DSH 回答里的数学公式复制成可在 Obsidian / LaTeX 中重新渲染的 TeX：悬停公式复制、选中带公式的文本时还原源码。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-math-copy

[![ci](https://github.com/SOH4C4759/dsh-math-copy/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/SOH4C4759/dsh-math-copy/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![license: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)

> 演示：[把 DSH 里的公式复制成能重新渲染的 TeX](https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1vVn56pEqi)（24 秒实录，无配音）

把 DSH 回答里的数学公式，复制成 **能在 Obsidian / LaTeX 里重新渲染的 TeX**，而不是一堆字形。

回答里的公式是 KaTeX 画出来的：看得见、选得中，但 Ctrl+C 之后进剪贴板的是 `𝑒^𝑖𝜋+1=0` 这样的 Unicode 字形——粘进 Obsidian 只会得到一行怪符号。这个插件把公式还原成源码：

- **悬停任意公式** → 浮出一个小条，三个复制目标：
  - `Obsidian` → 行内 `$…$`，独立公式 `$$…$$`
  - `LaTeX` → 行内 `\(…\)`，独立公式 `\[…\]`
  - `TeX` → 只给源码，不带定界符（一次性，不改后续格式）
- **选中带公式的一段文本再 Ctrl+C** → 剪贴板里是这段文本，其中每个公式都被还原成源码（用你上次点的 `Obsidian` / `LaTeX` 目标），整段直接粘进 Obsidian 就能渲染。
- 选中里没有公式时，插件完全不插手，复制行为与原来一致。

## 为什么源码是准的

KaTeX 渲染时会在视觉标记旁边同时输出 MathML，里面带一个
`<annotation encoding="application/x-tex">`，内容就是模型写的那段 TeX 原文。
插件只读这个 annotation，不猜、不从字形反推：

- 拿不到 annotation 的公式（渲染失败、被裁掉的节点）不会出现复制条，选中路径也会跳过它；
- 支持多行环境（`\begin{aligned}…\end{aligned}` 原样保留）；
- 不修改对话 DOM，只往页面上追加自己的浮条和提示，卸载时全部移除。

上次用过的目标记在 `localStorage['dsh.math-copy.format']`，默认 `obsidian`。
`TeX` 按钮故意不写入这个记录：临时要源码，不该把「整段还原」也变成裸源码。

## 安装

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:<本仓库绝对路径>
```

也可以从 DSH 的插件页安装同一个路径。装好后 profile 里是这一行：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: math-copy
      name: dsh-math-copy
```

装完插件即可用。**改过 `lib/client.js` 之后要刷新页面**（浏览器端 bundle 是页面启动时
import 的）；改 Host 半边才需要重启 DSH。

## 开发与验证

```powershell
node build-client.mjs        # src/client.js -> lib/client.js（校验 loader shell）
node --check lib/client.js
node tools/verify-client.mjs # VM + stub DOM：剪贴板载荷、annotation 提取、apply 接线
node tools/harness-run.mjs   # 无头 Edge + CDP：真的把公式 DOM 建出来跑一遍
```

`node` 不在 PATH 上时用 DSH 自带那一份：

```powershell
& "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\dsh-runtimes\dsh-primary-runtime\dependencies\node\bin\node.exe" tools\harness-run.mjs
```

没有 Edge 时 harness 会打印 `SKIP` 与原因（不会被当成通过）。

| 路径 | 是什么 |
|---|---|
| `entry.js` | Host 半边，空的：复制公式是页面的事，不需要路由、进程或设置项。 |
| `src/client.js` | 真正的实现（悬停浮条、选区还原、剪贴板回退、提示）。 |
| `lib/client.js` | 构建产物，由 `build-client.mjs` 从源码复制并校验；CI 会验证它与源码一致。 |
| `tools/verify-client.mjs` | 在 VM 里跑纯逻辑：三种目标的剪贴板载荷、annotation 提取、`apply()` 的监听与两个空槽位消费者。 |
| `tools/harness.html` + `tools/harness-run.mjs` | 用真实 KaTeX 结构造出公式，在无头 Edge 里跑 20 条断言：浮条出现/定位/不自动关闭、四种载荷、选区还原（含「无公式不拦截」）、滚动收起。`--dump-dom` 在本机对 HTML 页面返回空，所以改用 CDP 读页面结果。 |
| `tools/serve.mjs` | 单独起一个静态服务调试 harness 用。 |

CI（`.github/workflows/ci.yml`）跑语法检查、产物一致性、离线套件与浏览器 harness；
`.github/workflows/release.yml` 在 `v*` tag 或手动触发时打包 zip + npm tarball、在解包产物上
重跑离线套件，再发 Release。

## 已知边界

- 依赖 KaTeX 的 `.katex` / `.katex-display` 类名（KaTeX 自己的稳定契约），不依赖
  DSH 的 CSS Modules 哈希类名。
- 选区还原只在 `copy` 事件上生效；页面自己的「复制消息」按钮走
  `navigator.clipboard.writeText`，不经过这个事件——但它复制的是原始 markdown，
  本来就带 `$$`，不需要转换。
- 行内公式按 `$…$` 复制。源码里自带 `$` 的极端写法不做转义。
- 浮条靠悬停出现，纯键盘操作暂时取不到；需要的话可以再加一个消息级「复制全部公式」动作。

## 许可

[MIT](LICENSE)。

plugins.readme_text:
# opencode2dsh **Free OpenCode Zen models, natively inside DSH (DeepSeek Harness).** No API key. No registration. No extra process. [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@opencode2dsh%2Fdsh-plugin)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin) [![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/@opencode2dsh%2Fdsh-plugin)](https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh/blob/master/LICENSE) [![node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%E2%89%A520-brightgreen)](https://nodejs.org) [![DeepSeek Harness](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-plugin-blue)](https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh) English | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)
--- opencode2dsh registers a native DSH `LlmAdapter` that streams directly from [OpenCode Zen](https://opencode.ai/zen)'s **anonymous free lane** — the same models OpenCode's own CLI uses without an account, served to your DSH model picker as a regular provider called `opencode2dsh`. Requests leave your machine looking exactly like traffic from the OpenCode CLI (same user agent, same correlation headers), and the model catalog stays fresh through a three-tier fallback chain. There is nothing to log into and nothing to host. ## Highlights - **Zero credential, zero setup** — the anonymous lane needs no key; install, restart, chat - **Native adapter, no sidecar** — one npm package, no child process, no binary, no local port (the legacy Go sidecar is not part of the published package; see `legacy/`) - **CLI-identical disguise** — requests carry the OpenCode CLI user agent and its session/request/project header set, derived per conversation - **Selectable thinking levels** — reasoning-capable free models expose an effort picker in DSH's model selector (declared ladders where the model metadata provides them, Off/Minimal/Low/Medium/High otherwise); Responses-only `muse-spark-*` models expose only upstream-supported effort levels, and no selection keeps the provider default - **Image input where it is declared** — image attachments are accepted for every model whose [models.dev](https://models.dev) entry lists `image` in `modalities.input`, and refused for the ones that declare `text` only; models.dev being silent falls back to the live-verified vision family - **Live catalog with a fallback chain** — live upstream list ∩ free-by-metadata, falling back to offline cache and a verified static list - **Self-healing** — fast startup retries, periodic refresh, and a written health snapshot for diagnostics - **Proper error surfaces** — upstream failures (rate limit, auth, timeout, transport) arrive in DSH as classified finish reasons, and retries stay owned by DSH ## Install **From the plugin market** (recommended, once this repo is listed there): in DSH open **Settings → Plugin Market**, search `opencode2dsh`, one-click install. **From npm**: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add @opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin ``` **From source** (build the tarball yourself): ```sh git clone https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh.git cd opencode2dsh/packages/plugin pnpm install && pnpm pack dsh plugin --profile web add ./opencode2dsh-dsh-plugin-.tgz ``` **Verify**: restart `dsh web`, open the model picker, and pick a model from the **opencode2dsh** group. Requires DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 0.1.7 or newer with a web profile (the IP 池 settings page rides the 0.1.7 Plugins page contract); Node.js ≥ 20 (already present if DSH runs); outbound HTTPS to `opencode.ai` and `models.dev`. ## Configuration Defaults work out of the box. Override via the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`: ```yaml - id: opencode2dsh name: '@opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin' config: mode: adapter # adapter (default) | sidecar providerId: opencode2dsh refreshSeconds: 300 # catalog refresh cadence ``` | Option | Default | Description | | --- | --- | --- | | `mode` | `adapter` | `adapter`: native LlmAdapter streaming straight from Zen. `sidecar`: legacy local-agent mode, not bundled — build the agent from `legacy/agent` and pass `agentPath`. | | `providerId` | `opencode2dsh` | Provider name shown in DSH. | | `refreshSeconds` | `300` | Live catalog refresh interval. Pricing metadata refreshes every 24 h. | | `agentPath` | auto-resolved | Sidecar only: path to the agent binary. | | `agentArgs` | — | Sidecar only: extra CLI args for the agent. | | `restartDelayMs` / `restartMaxDelayMs` / `maxConsecutiveCrashes` | `1000` / `60000` / `5` | Sidecar only: restart backoff and circuit breaker. | | `firstEventMs` / `bodyIdleMs` / `responsesBodyIdleMs` | `30000` / `120000` / `300000` | Adapter only, plugin 0.3.7+: stream-liveness watchdogs, in ms (integers from `1` to `600000`). Time to the first stream event, mid-response body silence, and the body-idle floor for Responses models (`muse-spark-*`). Increase `firstEventMs` for slow cold starts. Unset keeps the defaults; restart DSH after editing. | ## How it works ``` DSH session │ harness chunks (block-start / text-delta / usage / finish …) ▼ ZenAdapter (registered LlmAdapter) │ pi-ai openai-completions stream (chat models) │ pi-ai openai-responses stream (`muse-spark-*`, Responses-only on Zen) ▼ https://opencode.ai/zen/v1 ← Authorization: Bearer public with CLI-identical headers: user-agent: opencode/… x-opencode-client, x-opencode-session, x-session-affinity, X-Session-Id, x-opencode-request, x-opencode-project ``` - **Session correlation** — session/project ids are SHA-256 derived from the conversation's first user turn (stable per conversation, non-reversible), and each request gets a fresh random id, mirroring the CLI. - **Catalog fallback chain** — S1: live `GET /v1/models`; S2: models.dev pricing metadata decides "free"; S3: a compile-time verified static list. A disk cache (~7-day TTL) covers upstream outages. - **Resilience** — the adapter registers immediately at startup; if the first catalog fetch races your network (VPN/TUN reconnects, DNS), the plugin retries on a short cadence (~1 min) before settling into the periodic refresh. - **Sidecar mode** (`mode: sidecar`, legacy) — spawns a local Go agent (a single-tenant port of [opencode2api](https://github.com/jasonxu114514/opencode2api)) on `127.0.0.1:`, token-authenticated, and registers a standard `llm-pi-ai` route. **Not part of the published package**; build it from `legacy/agent` (`go build ./cmd/agent`) and point `agentPath` at the binary. ## Health & troubleshooting The plugin writes a health snapshot after every refresh round: ``` ~/.opencode2dsh/adapter-status.json ``` ```json { "status": "ready", "total": 64, "exposed": 9, "lastError": "", "writtenAt": "2026-08-29T07:01:54.915Z" } ``` | Symptom | Likely cause & fix | | --- | --- | | `403 FreeTierError` / "OpenCode's free tier can only be used from within OpenCode" | The upstream restricts free-tier clients. The plugin preserves the explanation instead of reporting an invalid API key. Use the supported OpenCode client or an official API service. | | Boot screen shows `Failed to load plugins … list slot "plugins.item" requires options.id`, or the IP 池 entry has no configuration page | Your DSH predates the 0.1.7 Plugins page contract. Upgrade DSH to 0.1.7 (latest recommended). On 0.1.6 and older the page never mounts (it is gated on `configForms.whileServed`) — model routing is unaffected. | | DSH 0.1.7/0.2 cannot start after plugin installation (`pending … settingsScope`) | Upgrade the plugin to 0.3.5. On DSH 0.2, configure IP pooling through the installed opencode2dsh row on the Plugins page. | | Only 3 models | Startup fetch raced your network; retries land within ~1 min. Check `adapter-status.json` for `lastError`. | | `lastError: "fetch failed"` persisting | Outbound HTTPS to `opencode.ai` blocked; check proxy/VPN rules. | | Rate-limit errors in chat (`429 … Endpoint is unavailable`) | The anonymous lane is quota-per-IP and free models are contended. Since the fix for [#51](https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh/issues/51) the plugin's provider retry policy rides out 429 bursts silently (8 retries, ~1s→20s backoff, ≈90s worst case per step) instead of sur

plugins.description: A scholarly journal-desk skin for DeepSeek Harness: Nature, Science, IEEE and Elsevier covers, manuscript stages, and an editorial letter behind the conversation.
plugins.readme_text:
# Paper Skin · Journal Desk

A quiet, scholarly skin for **DeepSeek Harness**. Choose the paper you are publishing today — *Nature*, *Science*, *IEEE* or *Elsevier* — set the manuscript stage, and a professional editorial letter settles behind the conversation.

> A typographic homage only. This project is not affiliated with Nature, Science, AAAS, IEEE or Elsevier.

![Paper Skin in DeepSeek Harness](docs/preview-nature.webp)

## What it does

- **Journal masthead.** The sidebar becomes a deep cover-coloured spine with a typographic wordmark, a circular cover thumbnail, a journal descriptor and a slim colophon showing volume and stage.
- **Four covers.** Pick a journal from the small journal-cover button beside Harness **Settings**. The lower-left sidebar carries a slim colophon instead of a bulky journal switcher.
- **Manuscript progress.** Choose the stage in the same skin panel:
  - **初审 · With Editor** — initial editorial assessment
  - **中期 · Under Review** — peer review
  - **大修 · Major Revision** — revise and resubmit
  - **小修 · Minor Revision** — minor revision anticipated
  - **录用 · Accepted** — formal letter of acceptance
  - **见刊 · Published** — final article online
- **A professional letter, behind the conversation.** The selected stage renders a letter as the conversation background: a large stage word, editorial-office wording, manuscript number, date and a circular seal. It is a real CSS background layer, not a composer banner. Its visibility is adjustable from **5% to 80%**, and its colour can follow the manuscript stage or be set from a palette or the custom colour picker.
- **Journal artwork.** All four covers use the artwork in `assets/`: the Nature, Science and IEEE covers, and the Elsevier tree plus wordmark. The same artwork appears in the small journal button, the hero seal and the sidebar mark.
- **Visible paper grain.** A laid-paper texture runs across the conversation, composer, settings panel and sidebar, and can be switched off entirely.
- **Light & dark.** Paper, cover ink and watermark adapt to the Harness colour scheme.
- **Local only.** Choices live in this browser’s `localStorage` under `dsh.paper-skin.v1`. The skin makes no external network requests and collects no data.

![Paper Skin settings panel](docs/preview-panel.webp)

## Use

After installation, reload the page once.

1. The small journal-cover button sits beside Harness **Settings** at the lower left.
2. Click it to choose a journal and a manuscript stage.
3. The sidebar, cover colour, typography and the editorial letter behind the conversation change together.
4. `Accepted` uses a formal letter of acceptance; every other stage uses the corresponding editorial-office language.

The floating quick-settings pattern takes after [open-sea-skin](https://github.com/d-dev0101/open-sea-skin); the panel and skin here are an independent implementation. `open-sea-skin` is not required.

## Install

Paper Skin is a self-contained DeepSeek Harness bundle: one Host row (`paper-skin`), one Web client module, and a read-only local asset route. There are no runtime dependencies and no build step.

### From GitHub

Install the tagged release straight from the public repository:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:1552421144-cloud/paper-skin#v1.0.0
```

Or open Harness **Plugins → Add plugin → Install a third-party plugin**, paste the same `github:...` spec, install, then enable **Paper Skin · Journal Desk**.

### From a release tarball

Download `paper-skin-1.0.0.tgz` from the [release page](https://github.com/1552421144-cloud/paper-skin/releases), then install it into the same profile that runs Harness:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add /absolute/path/to/paper-skin-1.0.0.tgz
```

For the macOS Desktop app, the bundled CLI is:

```sh
"/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/Resources/runtime/cli/bin/dsh" \
  plugin --profile desktop add /absolute/path/to/paper-skin-1.0.0.tgz
```

Restart Harness, reload the page once, then open **Plugins** and confirm **Paper Skin · Journal Desk** is enabled. The bundle row is `paper-skin`.

### From npm

Once the package is published to npm, install an exact version:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add paper-skin@1.0.0
```

Or open Harness **Plugins → Add plugin**, enter `paper-skin@1.0.0`, install, and enable **Paper Skin · Journal Desk**.

### From a checkout

For development against a working copy:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "link:/absolute/path/to/paper-skin"
```

## Uninstall

Remove **Paper Skin** in **Plugins**, or:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove paper-skin
```

Unloading removes the CSS, root attributes, background watermark and every slot entry. The localStorage key remains until cleared.

## Compatibility

Verified against DeepSeek Harness Desktop **0.2.1-rc.2** on macOS. The client half uses the standard Web slots listed below, so it also works in a `dsh web` profile that has the same client packages. It does not modify the Harness checkout.

## Files

| File | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `client.js` | Browser skin: React slots, covers, stage letters, colour and opacity controls, CSS and the settings panel. |
| `index.js` | Host half; serves the cover artwork from `assets/`. It registers no tools, model context or session routes. |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Bundle patch inserting the `paper-skin` row. |
| `locale/*.json` | Plugin-manager metadata (English and Chinese). |
| `icon.svg` | Original journal-cover icon. |
| `assets/*` | Optimised Nature/Science/IEEE covers, the Elsevier cover, and the transparent Elsevier tree mark. |
| `docs/*.webp` | Screenshots used by this README. |
| `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` | Trademark and artwork attribution. |

## Slots

- `sidebar.brand.mark`, `sidebar.brand.name`
- `sidebar.footer.action` (slim colophon, not a switcher)
- `conversation.hero.brand.mark`
- `shell.overlay` (the only journal/stage switcher)

The conversation letter is a CSS background on the transcript surface; it adds no transcript rows. Cover artwork is served locally by the Host half from `assets/`. No app-root replacement, no external network requests.

## Packaging a release

```sh
npm pack
```

The resulting `paper-skin-1.0.0.tgz` contains only the runtime files, locales, icon, artwork, screenshots and documentation. The repository and release are at [1552421144-cloud/paper-skin](https://github.com/1552421144-cloud/paper-skin). Publishing to npm is optional and would allow installation by package name:

```sh
npm publish
```

## Licence

MIT for the plugin code. Journal and publisher names and the cover artwork are used descriptively; they are not official endorsements, and the artwork is not covered by the MIT licence. See [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md). All trademarks remain with their owners.

plugins.description: DSH plugin: restyles the conversation scrollbar to match the Visual Studio Code editor (14px, flat translucent thumb, light and dark themes).
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-vscode-scrollbar

A DSH (DeepSeek Harness) plugin that gives the conversation the **Visual Studio Code** editor chrome:

- the **VS Code scrollbar** — a 14px always-visible bar with a flat, translucent thumb that darkens on
  hover and lightens while you drag it, and
- the **VS Code minimap** — a scaled-down preview column on the right that shows the whole
  conversation, with a viewport slider you can drag or click to navigate.

The stock Harness scrollbar is a 5px, rounded, overlay-style bar and the conversation has no minimap
at all. This plugin changes only the conversation's scroll column; every other scrollbar in the app
(menus, code blocks, sidebars, the composer) keeps the stock look.

## What changes

**Scrollbar**

| Property | Harness default | With this plugin |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Track width | 5px | 14px |
| Track background | transparent | transparent |
| Thumb shape | pill (`border-radius:999px`, inset border) | flat rectangle, no radius |
| Thumb — light theme | theme scrollbar alias | `rgba(100,100,100,.4)` (`#64646466`) |
| Thumb — dark theme | theme scrollbar alias | `rgba(121,121,121,.4)` (`#79797966`) |
| Hover | theme scrollbar alias | `rgba(100,100,100,.7)` (`#646464B3`) |
| Dragging (active) | theme scrollbar alias | `rgba(191,191,191,.4)` (`#BFBFBF66`) |
| Scrollbar buttons | none | none |

These are VS Code's own defaults (`scrollbarSlider.*` in its light and dark themes;
`editor.scrollbar.verticalScrollbarSize` = 14). Dark mode is read from the
`body[data-ds-dark-theme]` attribute that the Harness theme service sets, so the colors follow the
active palette exactly like VS Code does — no plugin-wide color override, no second theme system.

**Minimap**

| Property | Harness default | With this plugin |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Preview column | none | 80px column flush against the scrollbar, capped at half the window height |
| Content | none | snapshot of the whole conversation, scaled into the column; images are painted, heavyweight media (video/canvas/SVG/forms) is dropped |
| Viewport slider | none | VS Code `minimapSlider`: square translucent band, visible only while hovering the minimap or dragging |
| Checkpoint rail | right-aligned at the edge, hidden under the preview | parked 110px from the right edge, left of the column and fully visible |
| Click | n/a | jumps the conversation to that point and keeps dragging from there |
| Drag / wheel | n/a | drag scrubs the conversation, the wheel scrolls it |
| "加载更早" pages | collapsed behind a button | expanded automatically, so older turns are never folded away |
| Minimum pane width | n/a | 1180px — below that the column hides instead of covering text |

## Behaviour

- The minimap only appears when there is spare room. The chat column is capped at 920px, so on wide
  windows the preview sits in the empty right margin; on a narrow window it hides rather than covering
  the messages. It also stays hidden while the conversation is shorter than the viewport.
- The column is flush against the scrollbar and capped at half the window height. Inside that column
  the whole conversation is mapped 1:1 through the preview scale, so the slider marks the exact
  preview slice the viewport is showing. (VS Code itself uses the full editor height; the cap is this
  plugin's only deliberate deviation from it.)
- The slider is VS Code's `minimapSlider`: a square translucent band in the scrollbar-slider colors
  that only appears while the pointer is over the minimap or while dragging (`showSlider: mouseover`).
  Its size and offset come from the conversation's own numbers (`viewportHeight * scaleY`,
  `scrollTop * scaleY`), never from the native scrollbar thumb.
- Clicking anywhere in the minimap centres the viewport on that line and then keeps the same gesture
  as a drag, so press-and-drag scrubs continuously. The wheel over the minimap scrolls the
  conversation, as it does over VS Code's minimap.
- Harness's turn-navigation rail (the short checkpoint bars on the right edge) keeps its stock position
  until the preview appears, then moves out of the column's way and stays clickable.
- Harness paginates old turns behind a "加载更早" / "Load earlier" button. The plugin clicks it as soon
  as it renders (paced while the button is in its disabled "加载中" state, capped at 500 pages), so the
  conversation is not folded into that bucket. This cannot be turned off without disabling the plugin.
- The preview refreshes after new content settles, debounced by 350 ms, so a streaming answer does not
  rebuild the clone on every token. Scrolling is rAF-throttled.
- It is read-only: interactions pass through the preview, and the clone has its ids, SVG, canvas, video,
  form controls and running animations removed, so it stays cheap and cannot interfere with the real
  conversation.

## Install / 安装

Install from GitHub into the profile you use:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:azkbzxf/dsh-vscode-scrollbar
```

Or install a local checkout through the plugin manager tool:

```json
{ "action": "install_bundle", "target": "D:\\path\\to\\dsh-vscode-scrollbar" }
```

A newly added bundle activates on the running instance: the Host row is live immediately and the
Client half hot-loads into the open page. Replacing an already-installed copy needs the page to be
reloaded (or DSH restarted) before the fresh client build is used.

Remove it again with:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> remove dsh-vscode-scrollbar
```

## How it works

The conversation scroll container ships no stable class name — its classes are CSS-module hashes
(`_727C8a_scrollBody`) that change between builds. It does ship a stable DOM contract, though: every
conversation body renders as a `[data-slot="conversation.session"]` element, and the shared shell
itself styles that relationship (its composer-overlay rules already use
`[data-slot="conversation.session"]`). Both halves start from that anchor.

**Scrollbar**

1. find each `[data-slot="conversation.session"]` anchor,
2. walk up to the nearest ancestor whose computed `overflow-y` is `auto`/`scroll` — that is the chat
   scroll container,
3. tag it with `data-dsh-vscode-scrollbar`, and
4. let a scoped stylesheet own `::-webkit-scrollbar*` for the tagged element only.

The stylesheet also carries a `:has(> [data-slot="conversation.session"])` selector branch, so the
bar renders correctly even before the marker is applied.

**Minimap**

1. A fixed-position layer is appended to `document.body` and placed from the scroll container's
   `getBoundingClientRect()`: flush against the 14px bar (`right - scrollbarWidth - 80px`), with the
   container's top, the container's width, and a height capped at half the window (or the container
   height when that is shorter). It is `z-index:30`, read-only and never takes layout space. While it
   is shown, a stylesheet rule parks Harness's turn-navigation rail (`nav[aria-label="轮次导航"]`) at
   `right:110px`, clear of the 80px column; with the column hidden the rail returns to its stock
   `right:12px`.
2. The chat column is measured on the **live** tree: every message row is a `[data-chat-flow-kind]`
   flex child of a column capped at `max-width: var(--dsh-chat-content-width)` and centred, so a
   rendered row reports the column width exactly. Measuring the clone instead would be wrong — the
   clone is detached from the ancestors that publish that CSS variable, so its rows reflow to the
   full pane width.
3. The anchor is cloned, sanitized in one tree walk, and given its own layout box: slot anchors render
   with `display: contents` (the outlet wrapper takes no box), so the clone is forced to
   `display: block`, sized from the pane's content width, and handed the measured column width as
   `--dsh-chat-content-width`. It is appended untransformed first, because the natural height is what
   the preview is fitted to.
4. The clone is transformed with `scale(sx, sy) translate(-columnLeft, 0)`: `sx = 80px / columnWidth`
   and `sy = columnHeight / naturalHeight`, so the whole conversation fills the (capped) column the way
   VS Code's minimap fits a file into its column. Images stay painted (a chat minimap with empty holes

# dsh-advisor-locale-ja [dsh-advisor](https://github.com/KnameSk/dsh-advisor) の **Advisor 設定画面を日本語化する**、独立した DSH プラグイン
## 概要 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）の **Advisor 設定画面**の文字列だけを日本語にします。 - **設定**・**相談予算**・**履歴**・**接続テスト**のタブと、その中にある項目名・説明・ボタン・エラー・確認メッセージを日本語化します。 - 翻訳がない項目は **英語でそのまま表示**されます（英語へのフォールバック）。 - **Advisor 本体とは独立**してインストール・アンインストールできます。 - **DSH 標準の言語設定に連動**します。DSH の言語が日本語のときだけ日本語で表示され、English や 中文 に戻せば元の表示に戻ります。 - **Advisor 本体の機能には一切影響しません。** このプラグインは翻訳の登録だけを行い、Advisor の設定値・相談処理・モデル呼び出しには触れません。 - 既存の翻訳辞書を壊したり上書きしたりしません。 ## 対応環境 - DSH `0.2.1-rc.2` - `dsh-advisor` `0.2.0` 以降 ## インストール GitHub から直接インストールできます。`` は実際に使用しているプロファイル名（`web` / `desktop` など）に置き換えてください。 ```bash dsh plugin --profile add github:KnameSk/dsh-advisor-locale-ja ``` **配布物として受け取る場合は、バージョンをタグで固定してください。** `main` を指すインストールは後日の変更で中身が変わるため、再現性がありません。公開済みのタグは変更されません。 ```bash dsh plugin --profile add github:KnameSk/dsh-advisor-locale-ja#v0.1.0 ``` アンインストールする場合は、次のコマンドを実行します。 ```bash dsh plugin --profile remove dsh-advisor-locale-ja ``` ## 使い方 1. DSH の **アカウントメニュー → Settings → General → Language**（**設定 → 一般 → 言語**）を開きます。 2. **日本語** を選びます。 3. **Settings → Advisor** を開くと、Advisor 設定画面が日本語で表示されます。 日本語を選ぶ手段は 2 通りあり、どちらでも動作します。 | 構成 | 日本語の選択肢を提供するもの | このプラグインの役割 | | --- | --- | --- | | `dsh-locale-ja` を併用 | [`@fang2hou/dsh-locale-ja`](https://github.com/fang2hou/dsh-locale-ja) | Advisor の辞書だけを追加 | | このプラグイン単体 | `dsh-advisor-locale-ja` | Advisor の辞書を追加し、**日本語の選択肢も追加** | `dsh-locale-ja` を併用する場合、このプラグインは **言語の定義を再登録しません**。言語の定義は `dsh-locale-ja` が所有し、このプラグインは Advisor の辞書だけを担当します。これにより、どちらのプラグインを先に読み込んでも衝突しません。 ## 翻訳の範囲 | 対象 | 翻訳 | | --- | --- | | Advisor 設定画面（`settings.advisor` 名前空間） | する | | DSH 全体の UI | しない | | Advisor の設定値・動作 | しない（文字列のみ） | `Advisor`・`Executor`・`Provider`・`block-tool`・`provider/model`・`/advisor`・`API`・`JSON`・`USD` などの識別子は、原文のまま表示します。 ## フォントについて このプラグインは **フォントを変更しません**。日本語表示用のシステムフォントは、言語パックである `dsh-locale-ja` が担当します。将来的に DSH 側でフォントが改善された場合に、古いフォント指定を上書きし続けないための判断です。 ## 開発 ```bash npm run check # 構文チェック + バンドルの鮮度 + manifest の整合性 npm test # ロケールサービス契約に対する検証 npm run build # dsh/client.js を再生成 ``` `dsh/client.js` は `scripts/build-client.mjs` が生成する成果物です。**手で編集しないでください。** ソースを変更したら `npm run build` を実行し、生成物もコミットします。`npm run check` はバンドルが古い場合に失敗します。 公開・タグ付け・タグ付きインストールの検証手順は [docs/RELEASING.md](./docs/RELEASING.md) にあります。公開済みバージョンは不変として扱います。 ### 構成 | パス | 役割 | | --- | --- | | `dsh/client.js` | DSH が配信するブラウザー用バンドル（生成物） | | `dsh/client/index.js` | クライアント側の入口。`locale` を inject して翻訳を登録 | | `dsh/client/japanese.js` | 言語と辞書の登録。衝突を避ける調停処理 | | `dsh/client/constants.js` | 名前空間と言語 ID | | `dsh/client/locale/ja.js` | 日本語辞書（169 項目） | | `dsh/index.js` | ホスト側の入口（Loader 行として登録するだけ） | | `cordis.patch.yml` | プラグインを有効化するパッチ | ## ライセンス [MIT](./LICENSE) ## 謝辞 このプラグインは、日本語化プラグイン [`@fang2hou/dsh-locale-ja`](https://github.com/fang2hou/dsh-locale-ja)（MIT、Copyright (c) 2026 fang2hou）が確立した **DSH Locale サービスへの登録方式**（`ctx.locale.addLanguage` と `ctx.locale.register` を `ctx.effect` で所有する構成、ホスト側を空の `apply` にして Loader 行として登録する構成、`dsh.client` で `immediately` と `inject` を宣言する構成）を手本にしています。ライセンス条件に従い、原作者に感謝します。

plugins.description: 支持不修改排版和格式的情况下进行文字、Word、Excel、PDF 与图片等格式的dsh ai翻译插件
plugins.readme_text:
# SACC Translator for DeepSeek Harness

Windows x64 翻译插件，复用 DSH 模型选择、语音输入和文档预览，支持文本及尽量保留原格式的文档翻译。

## 状态

当前源码对应 0.1.19，适配 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2。支持 CPU 版与自动绑定 GPU 组件的 CUDA 版。仓库只包含翻译所需源码，不包含 SACC 主应用、用户数据、密钥、日志或运行时二进制。

支持扩展名：doc/docx、xls/xlsx、ppt/pptx、pdf、png/jpg/jpeg/bmp/gif/webp、txt/md/csv/html/htm。复杂排版与 OCR 译文仍需人工复核。

## npm 安装（0.1.19）

官方“添加插件”输入 `dsh-sacc-translator-cpu` 或 `dsh-sacc-translator-cuda`。也可使用 CLI：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-sacc-translator-cpu
# 或
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-sacc-translator-cuda
```

npm 入口包约 26 KB。包管理器自动下载固定版本 GitHub Release 运行时；CUDA 额外自动下载 GPU 组件，无安装脚本。首次总下载量仍约 CPU 364 MB / CUDA 2.04 GB。不要同时启用两个版本。

基础运行时作为内部依赖 `dsh-sacc-translator-runtime` 引用已验证的 CPU 0.1.17 Release 包，用户无需单独安装或启用。npm 包不包含用户文档、设置、密钥或历史。0.1.17 完整 Release 安装方法仍可使用。

当前入口包构建：`npm pack ./packages/cpu` 和 `npm pack ./packages/cuda`。下面的完整包构建配方须先检出 `v0.1.17` 标签，避免混用版本。

## 0.1.19 更新

默认翻译并发为 5，已有设置保持不变。CPU/CUDA Bundle 均附带宿主预览配置：PDF/普通文件读取 1 GiB；Excel 256 MiB、100 万单元格、2 分钟；Office 输入 512 MiB、输出 PDF 1 GiB、转换 5 分钟。预览仍为整文件加载，大文件需要足够内存。宿主个人配置覆盖项优先。启用后重新打开 DSH，以便前后端加载配置。没有提高长期缓存上限。

这些配置作用于宿主共享预览服务，不仅是翻译面板。运行库继续使用固定的 0.1.17 / GPU 0.1.16 附件，格式支持及二进制未变更。

## 构建

0.1.17 发行包复用经过 SHA-256 校验的 0.1.16 运行时，保留已验证的格式支持。以下命令下载固定版本公开发行附件并构建三个包：

```powershell
python release/build_market.py --inputs .build/inputs --output plugins/dsh-translator/dist
```

输出 CPU、CUDA 与 GPU 附属包以及 SHA256SUMS.txt。构建只接受固定哈希的输入；源代码位于 plugins/dsh-translator，发行前端位于 packages/cpu 与 packages/cuda。GPU 二进制不存入 Git。

若修改 Python 文档处理逻辑，则需在 Windows x64 安装 requirements-build.txt，并在 .tools/libreoffice/runtime 准备官方 LibreOffice，使用 runtime/worker.spec 重新构建并完成文档回归验证，再更新发行输入哈希。Office 与 NVIDIA 等第三方组件保留其各自许可。

## 安装 0.1.17（Windows x64）

公共市场收录审核通过后，搜索“翻译 CPU”或“翻译 CUDA”。CPU 无 NVIDIA 依赖；CUDA 自动安装固定版本 GPU 附属组件，不需要手工下载 ZIP 或执行脚本。两个版本只启用一个，共用设置与翻译历史。

也可以直接使用 DSH 官方 CLI：

```powershell
# CPU（约 364 MB）
dsh plugin --profile desktop add https://github.com/piaomiaozhilei/dsh-sacc-translator/releases/download/v0.1.17/dsh-sacc-translator-cpu-0.1.17.tgz
# 或 CUDA（基础包约 364 MB，自动下载 GPU 组件约 1.68 GB）
dsh plugin --profile desktop add https://github.com/piaomiaozhilei/dsh-sacc-translator/releases/download/v0.1.17/dsh-sacc-translator-cuda-0.1.17.tgz
```

首次安装 CUDA 需要下载较大的组件，等待宿主安装完成；安装失败时在市场重试。组件不是独立 DSH 插件，无需启用，不单独列入市场。插件启用时校验 15 个 DLL 并自动挂载。运行时存放在 `%LOCALAPPDATA%/dsh-translator/runtimes` 的版本目录，避免 pnpm 深路径导致 Windows DLL 加载失败；同盘优先使用硬链接避免重复占用，跨盘才复制。该目录属于安装组件，不计入翻译文档缓存。首次校验和 CUDA 初始化可能需要一分钟。无兼容 NVIDIA GPU 时工作进程明确显示原因并回退 CPU。

已有用户请先结束翻译任务，通过宿主禁用旧版、安装新版，再启用所需版本；重启 DSH 后生效。更新不会删除翻译设置或记录。不要同时启用 CPU 和 CUDA。GPU 依赖下载失败会使 CUDA 安装失败，不会声称已完成 GPU 安装。GPU 组件校验失败会阻止文件翻译并提示重装，不会静默使用损坏文件。

0.1.17 复用已经验证的 0.1.16 文档运行时，仅更改安装依赖和组件挂载；没有模型、OCR 或文档格式逻辑变更。旧 0.1.16 ZIP/PowerShell 手动安装方法仅适用于旧版。

## 设置与隐私

模型调用由 DSH 完成，工作进程不持有模型凭据。CPU/CUDA 版本共用 DSH 数据目录下的 sacc-translator 设置和翻译记录。清理缓存会删除专属翻译产物及记录，不删除宿主共享附件。

请勿向仓库上传个人文档、翻译记录、环境配置、API 密钥或故障日志。问题报告优先使用自行构造的脱敏样例。

## 0.1.16 验证

18 种扩展名已通过本地固定模型响应的解析、回填及输出读取测试；旧版 Office 输出再转换后可读取，Excel 公式保留。GPU 可选组件安装后，三个 OCR 模型实际使用 CUDA。测试不代表对所有复杂文档或模型翻译质量的保证。

基础安装包约 364 MB；可选 GPU 组件约 1.68 GB，完整 CUDA 下载约 2.04 GB。首次 CUDA 初始化仍可能约一分钟；尚未实现跨任务引擎复用。

公共目录条目位于社区 awesome-dsh-plugin，审核通过后才能在 dshmarket 搜索。仓库 packages/cpu 与 packages/cuda 分别对应两个可安装条目，包内二进制仅通过 Release 分发。release/build_market.py 从校验过的 0.1.16 包可复现构建 0.1.17。

plugins.readme_text:
# ⚡ DSH 模型补齐助手（dsh-model-auto-enricher）

**告别在 DSH 里加完模型渠道后，还要把几十个模型一个个手动点开调上下文、勾图片、配思考强度的繁琐苦力活！**

---

## 😫 为什么做这个插件？（真实痛点）

在 DSH 里每添加一个新的中转站或第三方 API 渠道，里面往往有十几个甚至几十个模型。
但是在 DSH 默认设置界面里，拉取或添加完模型后，**每一个模型都得你自己手动点开去调**：
- 要一个个手填 **上下文窗口**（默认是空的，或者被限制在 128k / 200k，不改很快就会爆上下文）；
- 要一个个手填 **最大输出 Token**（默认是空的）；
- 要一个个手动勾选 **「图片」多模态开关**（默认只勾了纯文本，不勾根本发不了截图）；
- 要一个个手动打开 **「推理等级」开关** 并添加 `max` 档位（默认没开，开了也只有 `low / medium / high`，没有最高 `max` 档）。

**十几个模型一个个点开改下来，又麻烦又累；以后每次往渠道里新加一两个模型，还得再重复折腾一遍！**

装上 **「DSH 模型补齐助手」** 后：
👉 **你只需要在设置里把渠道和模型加进去、点一下保存，剩下的调上下文（100 万）、开多模态发图、配思考强度档位（`low / high / max`）全部由插件在后台自动帮你一次性搞定！**

---

## 🛠️ 具体帮你省掉哪些手动操作？

| 你以前要手动挨个调的项 | DSH 默认刚加进来时 | 装上本插件后（全自动） |
|---|---|---|
| **1. 调上下文容量** | 空白未填，或被截断在 `128k` / `200k` / `256k` | 自动全部拉满到 **100 万长上下文（`1,000,000`）** |
| **2. 调最大输出** | 空白未填 | 自动按系列补齐 **`64,000` / `128,000`** 最大输出 |
| **3. 调多模态（发图）** | 默认只勾了「文本」，聊天框发不了图 | 自动为所有模型勾选 **「文本 + 图片」（`[text, image]`）** |
| **4. 调思考强度档位** | 默认关闭，或手动打开后缺少 `max` 档 | 自动配齐 **`{ low, high, max }` 思考强度档位**（并保留已有自定义档位） |

---

## ✨ 核心亮点（v2.0 中文友好 · 全自动版）

1. **⚡ 添加新模型保存即自动生效（无需手动点按钮、无需重启 DSH）**
   - 插件在后台自动监听 DSH 的模型设置保存事件。
   - 只要你在 **「设置 → 模型」** 里添加了新模型并点击「应用」，插件会在 **0.6 秒内自动在后台帮你把百万上下文、64k+ 最大输出、发图支持、思考档位全部补齐**，并立即热重载生效！
2. **🧠 认识所有新模型（内置全系列规则 + 通用新模型兜底）**
   - 不仅完整识别 **GPT-4o / GPT-5 / GPT-6 / o1~o9 / Codex**、**Claude 4 / 4.5 / 4.6 / 5 / 5.5+ (Opus / Sonnet)**、**Gemini 2.5 / 3 / 3.5 / 4**、**DeepSeek V3 / V4 / V4.1 / R1 / R2**、**GLM 5 / 5.2 / 5.3 / Z1**、**Kimi K2.6 / K2.7 / K2.8 / K3**、**腾讯混元 Hy3 / Hy4**、**MiniMax / Step / Qwen / Grok / 豆包 / Llama / Mistral** 等全系模型；
   - **哪怕是你以后新加的、名字从来没见过的全新模型或内部代号模型**（如 `space-bunny`、`argon`、`astra`、`sol` 等），也会自动触发**「通用新模型规则」**，默认按顶配规格（`1M 上下文 + 64k 最大输出 + 支持发图 + low/high/max 思考档位`）一步到位补齐！
3. **🛡️ 100% 安全，只升不降，写前自动备份**
   - **只升不降**：如果你某个模型已经设了更大的上下文或更大的输出（如 `128000`），绝不会给你改小；已有的自定义思考档位（如 `off`、`medium`、`xhigh`）一律原样保留。
   - **自动备份**：每次修改配置文件前，都会自动在同目录生成带时间戳的备份文件（`cordis.patch.yml.bak-auto-enrich-YYYYMMDD-HHmmss`）。
   - **严格幂等**：所有模型已经是最佳状态时，不会改动任何字节，也不会产生多余备份。
4. **🖥️ 内置可视化管理面板（设置 → 模型补齐助手）**
   - 在 DSH 设置页左侧导航栏新增 **「模型补齐助手」** 面板，随时查看所有渠道与模型的健康状态、识别系列标签、上下文容量、多模态与思考档位明细，也支持手动一键补齐。

---

## 📦 一键安装

### 方式一：在 DSH 插件市场（dshmarket）中安装
打开 DSH **设置 → 插件市场**，搜索 **`dsh-model-auto-enricher`** 或 **模型补齐助手**，点击**安装**即可。

### 方式二：命令行一键安装

桌面版（`desktop` profile）：
```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add 66rapper/dsh-model-auto-enricher
```

网页版（`web` profile）：
```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add 66rapper/dsh-model-auto-enricher
```

---

## 📊 内置智能补齐规则表（v2.0）

| 模型系列 | 自动识别关键词 | 补齐上下文 (`contextWindow`) | 补齐最大输出 (`maxTokens`) | 模态支持 (`input`) | 思考强度档位 (`reasoningEfforts`) |
|---|---|---:|---:|---|---|
| **Gemini 系列** | `gemini / gemma` | `1,000,000` (1M) | `64,000` | `[text, image]` | 除纯 `lite` / `image` 生图小模型外全系开启 |
| **Claude 系列** | `claude` | `1,000,000` (老款 Claude 2/3 为 `200,000`) | `64,000` | `[text, image]` | `4.5+ / 5+ / opus / sonnet / thinking / high` 全系开启 |
| **DeepSeek 系列** | `deepseek` | `1,000,000` (1M) | `128,000` | `[text, image]` | `v4 / v5 / r1 / r2 / pro / flash / thinking` 全系开启 |
| **GLM 智谱系列** | `glm / chatglm` | `1,000,000` (1M) | `flash` `128,000`；其余 `64,000` | `[text, image]` | `5.2 / 5.3 / 6 / z1 / flash / high` 开启 |
| **Kimi 系列** | `kimi / moonshot` | `k2.6 / k2.7` 为 `256,000`；其余 `1,000,000` | `k2.8 / k3+` 为 `64,000`；其余 `32,000` | `[text, image]` | `k2.8 / k3 / k4 / preview` 开启 |
| **GPT 系列** | `gpt-* / chatgpt / o1~o9 / codex` | `1,000,000` (1M) | `64,000` | `[text, image]` | `gpt-5 / 6 / 7+ / o1~o9 / codex / astra / sol` 开启 |
| **腾讯混元系列** | `hy3 / hy4 / hunyuan` | `hy3` 为 `192,000`；`hy4+` 为 `1,000,000` | `64,000` | `[text, image]` | `hy3 / hy4+ / preview / thinking` 开启 |
| **主流大模型系列** | `minimax / step / qwen / grok / doubao / llama / mistral` | `1,000,000` (1M) | `64,000` | `[text, image]` | `step-5+ / grok-3+ / qwen-3+ / m3+ / thinking` 开启 |
| **🌟 通用新模型规则** | **任何未见过的全新模型 / 内部代号模型（自动兜底）** | **`1,000,000` (1M)** | **`64,000`** | **`[text, image]`** | **默认开启 `{ low, high, max }`** |
| **GPT 开源版** | `gpt-oss` | `128,000` | `64,000` | `[text]`（纯文本） | 不开启 |
| **残缺档位自动补全** | 任何已开启部分思考档位的模型 | 保持原值或拉升 | 保持原值或拉升 | 保持或补齐图片 | 自动补齐缺失的 `{ low, high, max }`，保留原有档位 |

---
